Here’s the God-honest truth: Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team. |
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6b7548a2af2942a88e54a88ba08c41f1&_e=4lDO7RJsJ_DXl-vOs5GXcsdSTWNyotAMC1_u607M3tT-pFkZm_JjSIVGgtxgkHBNuPT6ptzXC8SDemuzN2cYdZVUMdie8kfiKKEdZv7luk2siyA34VBCq01j9AwAvMzdPU3LXt-cYPqmkfCuo9e5vm_yUYK4YaAL_bEZ8BB76mSxlJVvklDMaveJk9m9H974Ij1pOLzzWbax30QfRJIMbHGKkuawJZR3g3iLgbry-YKmDNDKoNMJnmILEBiCt99B3uh0RLt382XFwM9eTQWfcN_umhTTx8CZLTvhaZfazB-Mkmibp_IVyRFHbqSxYVYIgHfwWTF-771gUqCdy5lrkdr5KLdTVXrO9oR0K46lRsstL50N_SdLf5bcQ9UH9L1DNnqPPFs--YjAnWPV3DgnHr49__2bnhi4eEbuMXR_4DSqoHL8blZN0UKS5GHAXyzI)

Here’s the deal, Peter.

I’m a straight shooter – always have been always will. You might not like what I have to say but I will _never_ sugarcoat the truth. _Trust me, we deal with that enough in Washington._

So, here’s the God-honest truth: **Republicans will lose in November if we don’t start acting like a team.**

**We’ll lose the House, and truly, I don’t think we can handle a single day of total Democrat control in Washington.**

What Democrats want to do to America is clinically insane – _they want to change our foundations, to make our country unrecognizable. They are wasting all of your hard-earned money to fund illegal immigrants, higher prices, defunding the police, forcing parents out of the classroom, and lining their own pockets._

You might be burnt out from the constant stream of news out of Washington, trust me I get it... but if you want things to actually change for the better, _**you have to pay attention.**_

[**We can’t sit back and take this way of life because if we do we’ll see Democrats take our country away.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6b7548a2af2942a88e54a88ba08c41f1&_e=4lDO7RJsJ_DXl-vOs5GXcsdSTWNyotAMC1_u607M3tT-pFkZm_JjSIVGgtxgkHBNuPT6ptzXC8SDemuzN2cYdZVUMdie8kfiKKEdZv7luk2siyA34VBCq01j9AwAvMzdPU3LXt-cYPqmkfCuo9e5vm_yUYK4YaAL_bEZ8BB76mSxlJVvklDMaveJk9m9H974Ij1pOLzzWbax30QfRJIMbHGKkuawJZR3g3iLgbry-YKmDNDKoNMJnmILEBiCt99B3uh0RLt382XFwM9eTQWfcN_umhTTx8CZLTvhaZfazB9O7ju3RYbEknNaN4VlbkR-wpXj7BvS16ukskZpVWOYEtSXSztA6QzTWJHYsmnBxlDvCugtLIqoK0ppL1VRWFvXoQs7kBxNXUDbJBHa5Qzz9b_jX1Jrvbh78d64vXewujqN8TzslWqUQrYwHKi_erER)

[**I need to know you’re on the team who still cares about freedom._I need to know you are on the team who’s willing to stand up and FIGHT back against the woke mob that is infecting our country._**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6b7548a2af2942a88e54a88ba08c41f1&_e=4lDO7RJsJ_DXl-vOs5GXcsdSTWNyotAMC1_u607M3tT-pFkZm_JjSIVGgtxgkHBNuPT6ptzXC8SDemuzN2cYdZVUMdie8kfiKKEdZv7luk2siyA34VBCq01j9AwAvMzdPU3LXt-cYPqmkfCuo9e5vm_yUYK4YaAL_bEZ8BB76mSxlJVvklDMaveJk9m9H974Ij1pOLzzWbax30QfRJIMbHGKkuawJZR3g3iLgbry-YKmDNDKoNMJnmILEBiCt99B3uh0RLt382XFwM9eTQWfcN_umhTTx8CZLTvhaZfazB_clliLgSsjgIepLPsjA2TM57D00Y_CIHtEX4ePnPSwv9T0FI7f70joNtIuzWCbDTR4-IqFrAxwMaupVE5q_q3Qx4kcgBOS8mLFY2QWd8dGrnhlDQxQ8P49NwtuEr0WjJ745vdYBPtMVeqgGSvC2nZ9)

[** JOIN THE TEAM ➞ **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=6b7548a2af2942a88e54a88ba08c41f1&_e=4lDO7RJsJ_DXl-vOs5GXcsdSTWNyotAMC1_u607M3tT-pFkZm_JjSIVGgtxgkHBNuPT6ptzXC8SDemuzN2cYdZVUMdie8kfiKKEdZv7luk2siyA34VBCq01j9AwAvMzdPU3LXt-cYPqmkfCuo9e5vm_yUYK4YaAL_bEZ8BB76mSxlJVvklDMaveJk9m9H974Ij1pOLzzWbax30QfRJIMbHGKkuawJZR3g3iLgbry-YKmDNDKoNMJnmILEBiCt99B3uh0RLt382XFwM9eTQWfcN_umhTTx8CZLTvhaZfazB-gvfwQNlGe_h9R2gN5iqsk1ZT-Z82hMOeATVneZJVbRyWY7ss8fEvwGcXx9SUf2d2URSxtmJnMi8pAyitvXgJI3mEUxrBEyCWgXKEWgpSpGAa1OOhJdvrMyc0XofIkmZ9TfUO-QPxwqg85YKy43k5r)
Think back on your life four years ago – were things better for you under President Trump? _Under a strong Republican majority in the House and the Senate?_

This chapter is super interesting because it is all about the **2 Great Witnesses** during the Tribulation. The popular view is that **Enoch** and **Elijah** are the 2 Witnesses. I disagree with this actually and will present a case for maybe a tag-team you have not heard of before. Watch [Revelation 11](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=14174986.7342.1.cb627b7ae0ac1e78ca7bc23a78b2ee6f) here: [https://youtu.be/scSquTnLv9Y](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=14174986.7343.1.6f1e7046921fbaa08334e32ed8665f70)

disclaimer_text: Paid for by River Gassen for Congress
body:
Jeff Crank's dangerous agenda threatens women's rights. Join me in fighting for reproductive freedom and healthcare access. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/jeff-cranks-lies-and-extremism-must-be-stopped?e=3818d77efc)
---
|
# Jeff Crank's Lies and Extremism Must Be Stopped
---
| Jeff Crank's actions and statements on abortion reveal his extreme and dangerous agenda. We must act now to protect reproductive freedom and ensure that voices like his do not prevail.
---
[](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=01cedd9bba&e=3818d77efc)
|
## Crank's Outrageous Statements and Actions
---
|
* **Supports a national abortion ban** : Crank has openly stated his support for a national ban on abortion, showing complete disregard for women's autonomy and health.
* **Dismisses women's choices as "**_**convenience**_**"** : Crank outrageously claims that [97% of abortions are for "convenience](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=63bf53c28b&e=3818d77efc)," an insult to all women who make deeply personal decisions regarding their own bodies. The reason a woman chooses an abortion is no one else’s business and should never be trivialized.
* **Endorsed by extremist groups** : Recently endorsed by the Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America Candidate Fund, Crank aligns himself with the most radical anti-abortion voices.
* **Involved with deceptive anti-abortion centers** : As a former board member of Life Network, Crank supports an organization that uses [deceptive practices to mislead women](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=27b470b180&e=3818d77efc) about their reproductive choices. Life Network falsely advertises services like abortion and emergency contraception to lure in vulnerable women, only to pressure them into continuing unwanted pregnancies.

---
| Crank's extreme stance threatens the rights and health of women across Colorado and the nation.
---
|
## Why We Must Act
---
|
* **Defend Women's Rights** : Crank's views are a direct attack on reproductive freedom.

Thank you, Kamala HQ \-----Forwarded message----- Sender: Kamala Harris Date: Wednesday, July 31, 2024 Subject: My Vice President selection Peter, I know many of you are eager to find out who I will be selecting to join me on the campaign trail, and hopefully in the White House, as my Vice President. Though I have not made my decision yet, it is important to me that grassroots supporters -- like you, Peter -- have direct updates about the state of the race. This campaign is about you. We are building a people-powered movement, and that foundational principle continues as we approach this next milestone. | | See this picture? That was the moment Joe Biden asked me to be his Vice President. It was perhaps one of the most memorable days of my life. After this call, Joe and I got straight to work uniting our country. Since being sworn into office, we have worked every single day -- together -- to move America forward. Joe’s and my partnership is something special. So you can trust me when I say: The selection of my running mate is not something that I am taking lightly. It is an important choice. Once I make the call, my running mate and I will get right to work -- just as Joe and I did. We will tour across major battleground states and then attend our party’s Convention. As I know all too well, that is just the beginning. So, as I prepare to ask that same question to a new candidate that Joe asked me back in 2020, I want you to be a part of the moment, too. It would mean the world to me to have you by my side as we take this next step in our campaign. | | Thank you and take care, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States | | | ---|---|---

Did you know that the Biden-Harris administration has approved **_almost 50% more oil and gas drilling permits on federal land_** in its first 3 years than the Trump administration did in its first 3 years? The Biden-Harris administration knows how to talk the talk by parroting climate-friendly buzzwords, but they haven’t walked the walk. **But Pro-Life Friend, I really don’t care what all these people think . . .**

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvdoht0kbfl8ukpob2r6rpb1luu2bdv14ula6ego_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cjgm0oj2c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1flo6qtp5l1u0jr0qdpa1pq2uc6f8tcfppg3jr0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cjgm0oj2c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z16krvm93joqbepmno0klo383t2jal04a8ce4ml0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cjgm0oj2c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6gt0fgtihqnu33m0o3pbhtb6jrpfckrq4is7sd0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cjgm0oj2c3h2bs)**

Fellow Republicans and Friends,
[Pledge your support](https://substack..7l_MnkgI7e-315Hrn3vrGSrERbSkZOIcaKsclZjAx3g?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147394889)
Early Voting for the Republican Primary started yesterday. We've been out on the Campaign trail for the past few months and now it is time to take action at the ballot box. I need your support so please get out and vote. **We are one week away from the Main Event.**
We have been identifying and posing solutions to issues facing the citizens of this district and will continue to do so. We have been looking at federal solutions to local problems that you and I face living in the Constitution State of Connecticut. We have also looked at world issues and issues that need to be addressed in Congress.
We've been out there: knocking doors, talking to people at Garbage dumps, talking to you, marching in parades, talking to our youth, talking to communities that have been ignored and also talking to people in the supermarkets about their pocketbook issues. **We have a pretty good feeling of the pulse of this State and This Country.**
Here are some of the issues that matter to Every Day Americans, which was a focal point of the RNC just a few weeks ago. This is not exhaustive. It also highlighted the growing Latino Vote and we have seen first hand at the Puerto Rican Day Parade where we marched that we are winning the hearts and minds of voters who have strong family values that are being ignored. ([See Article on the Hispanic Tide is Turning Red](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/the-hispanic-tide-is-turning-red?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web))
Connecticut has a border crisis. The inflation caused by immigration and bad economic policy is affecting everyone. The fentanyl and trafficking making its way to our backyard must stop. At the grocery stores, many people are waiting to shop on sale days and many are shopping at multiple supermarkets to take advantages of different sales. The sales price of groceries today were the regular prices under the Trump administration.
While Connecticut and it's Attorney General Tong keep attempting to expand their reach claiming that there's price gouging in our supermarkets, we have talked with independent supermarket owners that operate on typically less than a 2% profit margin and high volume. They are struggling due to high energy costs, supply chain issues, and theft. Connecticut separately has its own problem with theft of EBT snap cards and has to replace them so it's literally spending 2 times for the same person. Crime is rampant and our police need to be supported and this mantra of Crime Pays Under Biden and Himes needs to be reversed.
**Education** \- Parents want to be able to send their children where they want and we have been advocating for school choice. When we marched the Puerto Rican Day parade, so many parents expressed the challenges of working two or three jobs to be in a position to send their children to private or parochial schools because Bridgeport ranks at the bottom of the school districts of 161 out of about 165. ([See our article on Your Child, Your Choice.](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/your-child-your-choice?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web))
**Housing** is another major issue and not just 8-30g. Rents keep going up and the supply of housing is an issue in some parts of our district. Pricing is going up for inflationary reasons as cost of home heating is up. Cost of electricity is up. Cost of insurance is up. Hartford keeps jamming 8-30g down our throats. This mandate does not solve the real problem, which is enough affordable ownership of housing. **Our children cannot afford to live in Fairfield County.** (See our article on housing). **We Need a Return to Local Control.**
Your pensions and IRAs were devastated in the past week. This is due to Wall Street pricing in economic recession and the threat of global war in the Middle East with 12 US ships getting engaged in a conflict. This could have been avoided by the US simply supporting Israel with the arms that it required to fight the war for us without our troops being put at risk. Yesterday, Iraq attacked a US base and at least 5 U.S. Soldiers were injured ([See Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/640b25bd-f691-4f39-9cad-275e1d6dbe41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**Business** \- Companies are moving out of Connecticut. The only companies that come here are doing so because they have to. When they get here, they are stuck in traffic because I-95 doesn't move - You can blame Himes for that one - [See our article - When you Are Stuck on I-95 - Blame Himes)](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/i-95-when-you-are-in-traffic-blame?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web).
This infrastructure and energy crisis is causing issues to Commercial Real Estate Concerns and we need to bring more jobs to Connecticut with new pro-business strategies including: reduced regulatory burdens, expedited zoning and permit approvals, improving the infrastructure with less congested highways and improved commuter rail service. Federal tax incentives and opportunity zones are tools that can be used to attract new businesses to our beautiful state. These are techniques being used by other states to lure away Connecticut businesses. **We need to be more aggressive in both attracting and keeping businesses here.** ([See our Article on Addressing our Commercial Markets](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3260f67d-e447-4642-95fc-70d10ce61770?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**Electricity -** As for electricity, our bills have gone up significantly because of the public benefit which we drew attention to several weeks ago. Now everyone is picking up on it. And you are picking up on this when you get these outrageous energy bills in the dog days of summer. Why are we paying for others to improve their houses with solar and other energy saving initiatives, which should be borne by the electric company which benefits by reduces their need to supply additional electricity. You are not obligated to help your neighbor make improvements in a classic taxation without representation.
Why should you pay other people's bills in your energy bill? This is another form of a tax and probably questionable in its legality and most likely unconstitutional. However, the least that can be done is what I've proposed, which is to get a deduction on your taxes for this mandate, which is definitely what this is and make no mistake. These are now taxes being passed by non-governmental agencies, subject to governmental regulation and control. ([See our article on electricity](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8839409-f655-4f6e-923e-504b8482fd9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**The Border -** The border is another big issue, which is woven into many of these other issues as that has an indirect and direct effect on every aspect of our lives in Connecticut. I am all about closing the border. Most of Americans are in agreement. However, Jim Himes has been horrible on the Border and even suggested that we should bring refugees from Gaza. ([See our article on Hamas and Biden/Himes](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/no-process-is-strong-enough-to-vet?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web))
Speaking of Israel, Biden and Himes have been terrible on Israel despite the fact Jim Himes largest donor is AIPAC. After October 7, which is now more than 300 days later, Never Again is Now ([See Our Article Never Again is Now - 300+ Days Since October 7](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/never-again-is-now-300-days-since?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)). Himes has pandered to CAIR and was silent when both President Biden and Vice President Harris snubbed Netanyahu and Israel on a very important diplomatic mission. That was their first mission since October 7. ([See our Article on Biden and Harris Snub Israe](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/biden-and-harris-snub-israel?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)l) .
Following a historic speech by Netanyahu, Washington was looted. Flags were burnt by Pro Gaza Palestinian supporters, and nothing was done. There's one thing about free speech. There's another thing about inciting violence and desecrating government property and attacking our flag.
**Veterans** \- We've also talked about how veterans have been ignored with better treatment given to illegals and the lack of good resources for veterans to treat their PTSD and other ailments following their service to this grateful nation. ([See our Article on Our Veterans](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/what-about-our-veterans-vote-august?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)).
**WHAT CAN YOU DO?**
Now ask yourself what can you do. _**If any of these issues strike a nerve it is time to take action.**_ As we have been in the words of the Doobie Brothers - Takin it To the Street, it is your turn to **Take it to the Poll** s and Tell Your Friends. Cast your vote. It matters and you matter. So Let's build the greatest team going into this November to take back this country and as President Trump says let's make America Great Again.
We are out there working hard for the working people of America that have been ignored. You have recognized our efforts and as a result, we have more endorsements than any candidate running in the Primary. ([See Endorsements](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/34229958-75a8-4ae3-ab3e-26a83d068fe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
Early voting is available, however, we know most of you don't trust it. So Tuesday, August 13th, go out make your voices heard . **The silent majority can no longer be silent any longer.**
Thank you for your continued support and look forward to our next article as we continue to address federal issues to local problems that face every Connecticut resident. We will not be ignored any longer. It's time to take back this state and heal our country. **Put a doctor in the house and you can do that on August 13 by casting your vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein.**
**On August 13 th, Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13 so I can take on Jim Himes and solidify a team of Connecticut State Reps and Senators that support me and what we have been doing to build a strong bench for November's title fight. VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B.**
I would be honored by your support and tell your friends to get out and vote.
Thank you for your continued support. **This is a Rocky Moment and We the People Can Do this Together.**

() Connecticut has a border crisis. The inflation caused by immigration and bad economic policy is affecting everyone. The fentanyl and trafficking making its way to our backyard must stop. At the grocery stores, many people are waiting to shop on sale days and many are shopping at multiple supermarkets to take advantages of different sales. The sales price of groceries today were the regular prices under the Trump administration. While Connecticut and it's Attorney General Tong keep attempting to expand their reach claiming that there's price gouging in our supermarkets, we have talked with independent supermarket owners that operate on typically less than a 2% profit margin and high volume. They are struggling due to high energy costs, supply chain issues, and theft. Connecticut separately has its own problem with theft of EBT snap cards and has to replace them so it's literally spending 2 times for the same person. Crime is rampant and our police need to be supported and this mantra of Crime Pays Under Biden and Himes needs to be reversed. Education \- Parents want to be able to send their children where they want and we have been advocating for school choice. When we marched the Puerto Rican Day parade, so many parents expressed the challenges of working two or three jobs to be in a position to send their children to private or parochial schools because Bridgeport ranks at the bottom of the school districts of 161 out of about 165. () Housing is another major issue and not just 8-30g. Rents keep going up and the supply of housing is an issue in some parts of our district. Pricing is going up for inflationary reasons as cost of home heating is up. Cost of electricity is up. Cost of insurance is up. Hartford keeps jamming 8-30g down our throats. This mandate does not solve the real problem, which is enough affordable ownership of housing. Our children cannot afford to live in Fairfield County. (See our article on housing). We Need a Return to Local Control. Your pensions and IRAs were devastated in the past week. This is due to Wall Street pricing in economic recession and the threat of global war in the Middle East with 12 US ships getting engaged in a conflict. This could have been avoided by the US simply supporting Israel with the arms that it required to fight the war for us without our troops being put at risk. Yesterday, Iraq attacked a US base and at least 5 U.S. Soldiers were injured (). Business \- Companies are moving out of Connecticut. The only companies that come here are doing so because they have to. When they get here, they are stuck in traffic because I-95 doesn't move - You can blame Himes for that one - . This infrastructure and energy crisis is causing issues to Commercial Real Estate Concerns and we need to bring more jobs to Connecticut with new pro-business strategies including: reduced regulatory burdens, expedited zoning and permit approvals, improving the infrastructure with less congested highways and improved commuter rail service. Federal tax incentives and opportunity zones are tools that can be used to attract new businesses to our beautiful state. These are techniques being used by other states to lure away Connecticut businesses. We need to be more aggressive in both attracting and keeping businesses here. (). Electricity - As for electricity, our bills have gone up significantly because of the public benefit which we drew attention to several weeks ago. Now everyone is picking up on it. And you are picking up on this when you get these outrageous energy bills in the dog days of summer. Why are we paying for others to improve their houses with solar and other energy saving initiatives, which should be borne by the electric company which benefits by reduces their need to supply additional electricity. You are not obligated to help your neighbor make improvements in a classic taxation without representation. Why should you pay other people's bills in your energy bill? This is another form of a tax and probably questionable in its legality and most likely unconstitutional. However, the least that can be done is what I've proposed, which is to get a deduction on your taxes for this mandate, which is definitely what this is and make no mistake. These are now taxes being passed by non-governmental agencies, subject to governmental regulation and control. (). The Border - The border is another big issue, which is woven into many of these other issues as that has an indirect and direct effect on every aspect of our lives in Connecticut. I am all about closing the border. Most of Americans are in agreement. However, Jim Himes has been horrible on the Border and even suggested that we should bring refugees from Gaza. () Speaking of Israel, Biden and Himes have been terrible on Israel despite the fact Jim Himes largest donor is AIPAC. After October 7, which is now more than 300 days later, Never Again is Now (). Himes has pandered to CAIR and was silent when both President Biden and Vice President Harris snubbed Netanyahu and Israel on a very important diplomatic mission. That was their first mission since October 7. () . Following a historic speech by Netanyahu, Washington was looted. Flags were burnt by Pro Gaza Palestinian supporters, and nothing was done. There's one thing about free speech. There's another thing about inciting violence and desecrating government property and attacking our flag. Veterans \- We've also talked about how veterans have been ignored with better treatment given to illegals and the lack of good resources for veterans to treat their PTSD and other ailments following their service to this grateful nation. (). WHAT CAN YOU DO? Now ask yourself what can you do. If any of these issues strike a nerve it is time to take action. As we have been in the words of the Doobie Brothers - Takin it To the Street, it is your turn to Take it to the Poll s and Tell Your Friends. Cast your vote. It matters and you matter. So Let's build the greatest team going into this November to take back this country and as President Trump says let's make America Great Again. We are out there working hard for the working people of America that have been ignored. You have recognized our efforts and as a result, we have more endorsements than any candidate running in the Primary. () Early voting is available, however, we know most of you don't trust it. So Tuesday, August 13th, go out make your voices heard . The silent majority can no longer be silent any longer. Thank you for your continued support and look forward to our next article as we continue to address federal issues to local problems that face every Connecticut resident. We will not be ignored any longer. It's time to take back this state and heal our country. Put a doctor in the house and you can do that on August 13 by casting your vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein. On August 13 th, Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13 so I can take on Jim Himes and solidify a team of Connecticut State Reps and Senators that support me and what we have been doing to build a strong bench for November's title fight. VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B. I would be honored by your support and tell your friends to get out and vote. Thank you for your continued support. ## Markets Continue to Slide
[Markets fell](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEbeBXxQuPgbuvvblGhtlsOJwQj2QHn7iNRpRiONZjT6Pp7Dk2KK6-s_LexkygMFiScPrbYa66EuRjcxI1cFO3ggdg0gdMXsoCFowRCgxYp8qLoGbGtrP5K3k22L6NBgbVpjwRhrutJOBk3j_YOJ_ASgasNjlLyXnzmuMvOUvvPJexnyUiQ3i2yHqv4p7BX213WVYfXhDhX297TC3rS3NAp70LLHlGJe9RU3zm_RC-1fLHq__fZe4zHzoRd-kQ60aeEwl7MsqdjduF1397APVZvXQjH9fpA_gZwOfwIAAP__lNdh8A) severely on Monday, highlighted by the seven most valuable U.S. tech companies losing about $1 trillion in market value.Monday's decline began with [Japan's Nikkei falling](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL8GOqL1YmxcuHhNurz2SrQ262QPgyOwiPL3p1x95WiKkebrNt1Ismz3_7Syr6lMFKucPI2d6VBPup19YkbuW_bKIrpBoXLtwwM6mrF3LoJz0QyjHpIGAyFAsGqkVjwCahjBKAAD7mISIAwhWCYKSalGA89Sy375LrLVB6f8Lifvl1jWNvtHrc-j6f81eG3wSs-NX8dHfWCvEjM3eD1qicvRrbQvXI9uk2Vh6TiWrazvLhrU4Kxlp0cMySJYCnHoA5JSPIzt7ufnS3KWw9hGw30lyb_5-ueL0-NPAAAA___o5F88) 12.4%, marking its worst day since the 1987 Black Monday crash. In the U.S., the S&P 500 dropped 3%, the Dow plunged 1,033 points, and the Nasdaq decreased by 3.4%.Tech companies were [among the worst performers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuhDAQRL_GdKD1YjhTuEhDd2lTogWvD-fMGcEGdH8fkTrNaKSR5ul93Yc7xRRfj09a2EnIA00SDx5s2ZZoBlN4F5iR64KdviF2jUbdFbOjBuvQ2RG7zhrSZBvT1nayjfUNUO2L6BDQgIVWA7TQVW0AhGYcb0w0Bq2VAfZR8lZ95_iSmUN654O3aspLkdwssu6q_lDYK-zP86ym1zhdo8L-ulbYg73iarvk6VkutD1ZSsme3mWKB5c_qyfhvZplScXm_HrGlOLe3pSBx0Ix_dHkX_XD4W8AAAD__1CNWb8) on Monday as Nvidia lost 6.4%, Apple fell 4.8%, Tesla dropped 4.2%, and Super Micro Computer was down 2.5%.The markets' performance and a poor July jobs report have ignited concerns that the U.S. economy is slowing. [Investors are worried](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAURL_G7q4FhOC4oMgr3OW1W1oXc7HJYsgCiZX9-pW33mqkGWl0dD5u0w198HH5jxvp6tKEc_Uvmi6gQMhJtlY7IkGnljTvhRjOXPChXXWv3IWITkhW9Q5Nr5SRzBg5zM71Z9l6LZiQ7MIUZ0yxoVOOCXY2pidE4zhvJCPra8rdPflYV3LhnV6UuzltbdBrrY_SnK6NGBsx7vvebSUeWyNGivAsjRi3FOl9JOZPqkezYwhQaiaqYEJK1mBdwaYdIhaLX_AIz7gQbCkT1BUjcGCMAW7eQqaZSvEpgiPMxx1muF55Wu7_vtus7WP3Ifii-kayZUMfflnrn-JeWvwEAAD__6VLcnk) that the Federal Reserve has moved too slowly and will need to play catch-up in cutting rates.
## Google Loses Landmark Antitrust Case
A federal U.S. judge ruled on Monday that Google has [illegally maintained a monopoly](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu7CAQheGnwR0WjDE2BcVt3O1tU1oDHttELKyAXStvH22qFOmO9DVH_8dtvWGIIR3_8U627XlF38KL1plrDmpV3WZ3IqChIysnADNKkKY7rXPGbNrrQeMoxwE3j7M384TbtM8GVBcsCFBiFloKoYXp9S5AjM5NhOh2KZkStIWWS_-ZQ2on7fErv6j0Pt-7aM_WHpUN_xgsDJbruvrkfKKrvp3B4p41JKr11-RvZrAcOR-ReMyVKsfUQivP2rjHSrwSFn_y4hNKPYLSXbHb4woxhqonpsRxxxB_PrQ_g7wsfAcAAP__ietkyA) in search and text advertising markets, violating antitrust laws.The government alleged that Google created strong barriers to entry to maintain its dominance in general search.The court focused on Google's [exclusive search arrangements on Android and Apple](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAURp8GO8zlDqAWFH9jN3-7pUG5KBNGJoCaffuNW2_5JV9OTs7Xc3raEMO-_rdvMtWnyS41nDT1XHOUk2yc8URIj4aM6BAHJVAMzWasUlbqeQCPCyil_Oxw0VYIUE7prm-CQUAJPWgBoGFotQcENc8dWTt7IZgEcqGm3L5S2OtGPn6nk3K7pHcTzVbrp7DHP4Yjw_G6rrZudFJe6T4wHG88w7FnOKp7SqGUQmA4vg63Es9HpMLTzo_CXXrxk68prZG43Wuo-SiVF7J52Xg5Qm2ycZ8rxBiK7piE9W1D_FWpf3Y5Df4EAAD__x0yY4Y) devices as evidence of anticompetitive behavior.This case is part of a broader push by regulators [to scrutinize big tech companies](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHOozAQBp_GdKD1xjZx4eIad7n2SmRgMXtycARLUN7-lKv_9tMnzWj-PIZH4sJb_p2eFGSpQ5qE3zTcW9eiGUwzh4UI6dZQ0D2itxq1b9YwTg7BW0M4WePMTAT9zafF2157b7HhgIAG7uA0gAPfuQUQ7Dj2lNK4aK0M0MxS9-5v5U1WWsqnvmnvpvpsSlhFXoe6_VIYFcbrujpZKZ9pnzlt34_CKDStWy01fxTGtAtPhRTGL_g7nFlhBKsw5lpzobbUg442bcKyn4e0JV3HydLsYX5dXAofrlcG8jNx-a8hPzZ5B_wXAAD__3IgZAE) for monopolistic practices, with Google facing another antitrust lawsuit later this year focused on its advertising practices.
## Hurricane Debby Lands in Florida, Moves Southeast
Tropical Storm Debby made [landfall in Florida as a Category 1 hurricane](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7oiWNQZTULwmXV57pQVmsfeETYRJovz9KVdfOZpmNF-3-eY587H-9zu5lsrsl8ZPmiehBapZ9dElIqShJycNoh0lSttvbrBEyiayqDwOxo9gkKJc9ChBD4A9OwRUMIGWABrsRSdAGEMw5H1IUnYKKHIr9fJd-GgbpfwuT6qXpex9dltr97Mb_nV47fDq7we9zo_6QG28ZOrwuj1q5cUfJCKF8BYplxL5WMXZSt3F-agriY3XTbz4iKegYNMyQhzNNKE2k5pQpWEM3qrB6-j76uL9xTnzqU2nYN0959-g9uedp8OfAAAA__9ewmY3), causing flooding and at least four deaths.The storm is now moving towards Georgia and the Carolinas, with forecasts predicting up to 30 inches of rainfall in some areas. [Here's the timing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uKyEQRp-G7bCGMftXUNxmO9825WpYBkPELhZgW377yImUKu05xffpfFzWC8UUj-t_2tk0n1faWnzwOslBol5154xnRj53bNSIOPcK1dwF463WvZpJ90Cz89PmncV50JsHrRSNXTQIqGGCQQEMMJ8GDwi9tSMTWa-U0MAutlxOnzkeLbBPr_zgctry3iUTWrtVcf4ncBG4PJla-HECl9py2avAJdxLiRsdLHA5-PlG71UJk4Re_lrp2NqXTHQ4TylJn3KJjmTN9xaYanuT7KTPhTeqrSvG3Z4xpViHUWi47hTT96_2Z6SHwa8AAAD__waaaxs) of the most serious flood threats for the next few days.Over [300,000 people lost power](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGunDAQAL_GdIvWe5yBwkUaupc2JVrw-nBibGT8QPf30aVOPdJoNL--5i8OMaTXT97FVp9nXmu4ZB7AAHVz1zjrRUgejVjdE41PTXpsNvvww2pwND0uo_FP9GZB37sVkUYSkiZYQupwQKMRDY6t8Uj4XJZemBevtepQXKi5tL9zSHUTH9_5ktKueW-i3Wo9TvX4oWhSNN333b55y_lDFU1J7lPRFMMliqbtu5SwchJwsixvcPlOr8JOHNQMteQjrBzhrLnswL5KgcjJeY4RQgIfcwmO4WOD78NxlRM4OTi4blALr3-kgH7oThMOz3are2yKdccdYgyn6VWHr51D_Jde__vxsvQ3AAD__zEmd_k) across Florida and Georgia, and thousands of flights were canceled.Emergency officials in affected states are warning residents to stay vigilant and prepare for potentially historic flooding events.

body:
Sorry if that hurt your feelings!

->

Folks,

My appearance on Neil Cavuto's Fox News show was an interesting one, but once I got my thoughts out, I think the American people were glad to hear somebody say the quiet part out loud.

**They see the bungled border and hell-in-a-handbasket path we're on and believe that Vice President Harris is a ding dong, plain and simple. After we've had one Vegetable in Chief for the past four years, they do not want another so-called leader who couldn't run a food truck.**

She is not a serious person. I never saw Margaret Thatcher giggling while her citizens were struggling to make ends meet.

"Momala" Harris is nothing more than an unserious San Fran Democrat who wants to have abortion-on-demand, Hamas victory "from the river to the sea," a dissolved border, criminals' rights over cops', and to replicate her "success" in Afghanistan.

At the end of the day, President Trump is going to beat Kamala Harris; the Presidential election will not be close... as long as Republicans keep their feet on the gas. The Senate, on the other hand, is another story. It's going to be too close to call.

**That's why I'm reaching out to you, my friend.** Just because the majority of the American people don't want to vote for a ding-dong, doesn't mean the Democrats don't have some tricks up their sleeves. It's imperative that we, as American Patriots, come together and support one another.

I'd love to give Kamala something else to giggle about when she sees her Loon Wing of the Democrat Party get fired and kicked out of Washington, D.C.

Thank you,

Senator John Kennedy

body:

| Campaign Update
---
---
| | August 6, 2024 Today I'm honored to announce that Peter Wolfgang has personally endorsed my candidacy for the Republican nomination for Congress in Connecticut's 4th District. Peter heads the Family Institute of Connecticut, the most effective group championing traditional family values in the state.
---
---
---
Peter and I have known each other and worked together on rallies and lobbying in Hartford for many conservative issues over the years. It's a tough task, fending off and defeating proposed legislation targeting conservative traditions and values, time and again. I appreciate Peter's kind words and am grateful for his belief in my candidacy and his Endorsement.
After 16 years, you can help us return true Representation to the solid citizens of CT-4, by retiring Jim Himes back to private life. Let's finally end the Jim Himes chapter and return the citizens of CT-4 to their rightful seat at the table. Help is on the way! In liberty,

## Austin Tops List of Sweatiest U.S. Cities

body:
The politics of pets in CO? More than 5,300 dogs euthanized in 2023 alone...
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
I had a great time co-hosting the The Dan Caplis Show last night! We had a conversation on Trump's sentencing with Mike Davis of the Article III Foundation, discussed the stock market tumble, and lots of talk about Kamala (esp. her VP pick, expected to be announced soon, I’m guessing it’s Tim Walz, Gov of MN). [Listen here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, August 6, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Sold out: Trump will visit Aspen for fundraiser and you most likely can’t get a ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The hardest ticket to get in Colorado this week — and the most expensive — will be a seat to be in attendance when former President Donald Trump returns to Colorado._
__
_He will address a crowd Saturday in Aspen, making his first campaign appearance since 2020, when he stumped for former U.S. Sen. Cory Gardner._
__
_A seat at the dinner for a couple will cost $25,000, while host levels for a couple cost $100,000 and $500,000. But, the invite on the Trump 47 Committee page indicates the event is sold out. The invite did not list a time or location for the fundraiser._ ____
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘The Kamala Crash’: Trump terms market selloff as ‘preview’ of world without him in the White House](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1,000 points as markets opened, with significant losses among major tech companies like Alphabet, Apple, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Tesla, collectively facing potential losses of up to $1 trillion.
* Former President Donald Trump attributed the market crash to weak leadership under Kamala Harris and warned of a "Great Depression of 2024," linking the market's decline to her recent securing of enough delegate votes for the Democratic nomination.
* The market downturn was seemingly triggered by a disappointing job growth report which added only 114,000 jobs in July against an expected 175,000, raising fears of an economic slowdown or recession.
* Trump also noted that consumer costs have risen by 20% since the Biden-Harris administration took office, contrasting with stock market performance under his presidency, which saw a significant increase.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ganahl: The Politics of Pets in Colorado, Part 1](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In Colorado, the pet rescue situation is critical, with over 5,300 dogs euthanized in 2023 due to shelter overcrowding and resource shortages.
* A significant issue in Colorado's animal welfare is the political and financial entanglements that complicate effective management, including involvement from Governor Polis and notable nonprofits.
* Current legislation in Colorado mandates sterilization before pets are sold or adopted, but loopholes allow some organizations to bypass this, particularly with animals claimed to be born in Colorado, worsening the crisis by keeping more adoptable dogs from finding homes.
* Ganahl calls for stricter enforcement of sterilization laws, reducing exemptions to when an animal’s life is truly at risk, and encourages public participation in upcoming regulatory meetings to influence better policies for animal welfare. Check out [CBS Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for a special report by Shaun Boyd on this topic!

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Driven by recession concerns, market plunges; Dow opens down 1,000 points, Big Tech stocks fall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. stocks experienced significant losses, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average falling 2.6% and the S&P 500 dropping 3%, marking the worst trading day since September 2022, fueled by fears of an impending recession.
* Economic indicators such as a weak jobs report and declining manufacturing activity, alongside disappointing earnings and bleak forecasts from major tech companies, contributed to the market downturn.
* The market's reaction also triggered the "Sahm Rule," a historically reliable indicator of recession, which predicts an economic downturn when the three-month moving average of the jobless rate rises by at least half a percentage point above the lowest rate of the past 12 months.
* Global markets were also affected, with Japanese stocks recording significant losses and the Nikkei 225 index experiencing its worst day since 1987. Cryptocurrencies were not spared from the sell-off, with significant declines in major currencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[The University of Denver is joining the STARS College Network to recruit more rural students](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CHALKBEAT COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The University of Denver has joined the Small Town and Rural Students College Network (STARS College Network) to help increase college enrollment among students from rural communities. The network includes 32 public and private universities like Yale, Vanderbilt, and Duke.
* Despite higher graduation rates, rural students are less likely to attend college compared to their urban peers. Nationally, about 55% of rural students go directly to college, compared to the average of 61%.
* The University of Denver plans to actively visit rural high schools, particularly in Western and Southwestern Colorado, to encourage more applications from rural students. They aim to dispel misconceptions about the accessibility of selective colleges for rural students.
* The university emphasizes that financial aid is available and that they are committed to supporting rural students’ academic success, addressing concerns about affordability and academic preparedness.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Hardin: Understanding Colorado House Bill 24-1174, a shift in concealed carry training](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Colorado’s landscape for concealed carry permits is set for a significant transformation with the introduction and passage of House Bill 24-1174._
_This legislation, effective July 1, 2025, emphasizes more stringent and uniform training standards for applicants and renewals of concealed handgun permits. Let’s delve into what this means for current and prospective permit holders._

Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is the strongest independent candidate in a generation.

Dahlstrom Statement on Tim Walz Joining Kamala Harris' Ticket

ANCHORAGE, AK - Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom, Republican candidate in
the Alaska at-large House race who was endorsed by President Donald
Trump, issued the following statement on the most leftist presidential
ticket in American history after Kamala Harris selected Minnesota
Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.

Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said, "Alaskans have already felt the
brunt of a Biden-Harris ticket, but the Harris-Walz ticket will be so
much worse. This ticket is only a continuation of the Biden-Harris
administration's disastrous agenda which has caused record high
inflation, an increase in crime, and a border crisis. Meanwhile, May
Peltola will remain silent, vote with Harris-Walz at every turn, and
continue making Alaska irrelevant. Now more than ever, we need new
leadership this November and I look forward to working with the
Trump-Vance administration to turn our country around."

Friend -
Today is Michigan's U.S. Senate primary.
By the time we wake up tomorrow, we will know who our opponent will be in the general election.
If history is any guide, we also know that the moment the Republicans have their nominee, that person will enjoy an enormous fundraising and volunteer boost. They'll also get the support of the National Republican Senatorial Committee.
It is also the moment that the outside spending groups waiting to attack us will begin to rev up their engines as well. The truth is, they have already reserved millions in TV time, and have ads already in the works just waiting for this moment, so they can turn on their attacks the moment the general election begins.
So this is one of those major inflection points in our race: the day before we find out our general election opponent, and start the final sprint to November.
That's why I am asking for your help this morning. Because it's not enough to be ready on day one -- we have to be ready _before_ day one.

| We're pumped, friend.

With Minnesota Governor Tim Walz joining the Democratic ticket, we're confident that his record of climate action in Minnesota will help build support across the country for Vice President Harris's vision to move America forward.

To further underscore why this is such a huge deal for our movement, **here are just a few of Governor Walz's climate accomplishments:** |
---
|
* He [signed a bill to hit 100 percent clean energy by 2040 in Minnesota](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2744199/87SdQ4wZ)—one of the most ambitious clean energy standards in the country—and he got it done with a single-vote majority in the state Senate.

* He [built the Minnesota State Competitiveness Fund](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2744200/87SdQ4wZ), which has helped the state secure hundreds of millions of dollars in federal investments to support community-driven climate solutions.

* Understanding the barriers standing in the way of clean energy deployment, he [signed a bill](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2744201/87SdQ4wZ) that will help the state deploy clean energy faster.

* He consistently secured funding for mass transit while in office, and his administration is now [implementing a nation-leading law that incorporates climate into transportation investments](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2744202/87SdQ4wZ).

|

| | Fellow Conservative, Every week there's another horrific story that makes the news. There are countless others that are not as widely reported.

Innocent men, women, and children alike are being robbed, assaulted, raped, and brutally murdered in our country by illegal immigrants - _and the Democrats DO NOT CARE_.

Last month, in my hometown of Houston, 12-year-old Jocelyn Nungaray was murdered by two illegal immigrants who the Biden administration released on Alternatives to Detention (ATD) - despite their being roughly 3,000 ICE detention beds available at the time.

_I 'm not going to let them forget Jocelyn's name._

_I 'm fighting to make sure this can NEVER happen again._

**I 've introduced the ****Justice for Jocelyn Act****in the U.S. Senate and I 'm working to build broad support to get it passed.**
**[**RUSH SUPPORT TO FUEL OUR FIGHT AT TEAM CRUZ >>>**](http://trk.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9KdXN0aWNlLWZvci1Kb2NlbHluLUFjdF8yMDI0MDcxNiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUp1c3RpY2UtZm9yLUpvY2VseW4tQWN0JnV0bV9hZ2VuY3k9UEcmYW1vdW50PTQ5JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlIn0/ZovavYlQugm6oz1uzJu9PQ)**
The Justice for Jocelyn Act would do the following:
---
* Prohibit the release of any illegal alien to ATD if there are detention beds available;

* Require illegal aliens in the ATD program to be subject to GPS monitoring;

* Impose curfew restrictions on illegal aliens in the ATD program;

* And empower immigration officers to immediately deport illegal aliens who break any of the ATD rules, including those above.

---
The Biden Border Crisis is the result of dereliction of duty unlike anything we've seen in our nation's history. **Joe Biden, DHS Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas, and the Democrats and corporate media that run cover for them have blood on their hands.**
I will never let up in the fight to stop this insanity and hold them accountable.

**[I'm grateful to have you standing with me and appreciate any support you can send >>>](http://trk.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9KdXN0aWNlLWZvci1Kb2NlbHluLUFjdF8yMDI0MDcxNiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUp1c3RpY2UtZm9yLUpvY2VseW4tQWN0JnV0bV9hZ2VuY3k9UEcmYW1vdW50PTQ5JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlIn0/kDJwaeWqbFT68bqivAIR3Q)**

Ted Cruz

Friends,
It’s becoming a pattern.
Trump’s gonna Trump... and flunkies gonna flunky.
Trump stuck his foot in his mouth (again and again) at a town hall conversation with Black journalists. Went back to birtherism, questioning the Vice President’s race, lied and attacked the moderators. Had to be pulled after 35 minutes.
It was so bad that even most MAGAs around the country stuck their heads into the nearest sand they could find. The old “la la la la not listening” defense. Even Tommy Tuberville from Alabama and his colleagues from Mississippi didn't try to defend Trump on this one.
But New York’s Nick LaLota?
While he was enjoying a six-week vacation because House Republicans can’t even pass a budget, LaLota doubled down on Trump’s lies. Defended the slurs. Said no President has done more for Black Americans since Nixon (seriously). Said that Trump wins on facts (seriously). That’s the opposite of common sense.
This is what we’re up against, and we think it’s a firing offense. If you agree, pitch in and let’s keep No-Show Nick on permanent vacation >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general-0805]
Why did Nick decide to stick his neck out for his Dear Leader?
Because he does whatever Trump says and defends whatever he does. And the carrot? $700k+ in dark money in an effort to confuse Suffolk County voters.
Trump gonna Trump. Flunkies gonna flunky. Rinse and repeat.
If you look at the latest polls, the House margin is going to be razor thin. It likely could come down to NY-01.
The question is: do we want a Trump flunky or do we want someone who’ll be an independent voice for Suffolk County families? Do we want someone who’ll push a national abortion ban or someone who will defend reproductive freedom? Someone who will follow Trump’s lead on raising taxes for middle class families or someone who will actually restore the state and local tax deductions?
The choice is pretty clear. Lying Nick Lalota is far too right for New York. We just can’t afford another Trump flunky in Congress.
We’ve got just 13 weeks until the election. We are taking the fight to No-Show Nick every day. But he’s got a $700k head start with his avalanche of TV ads. Can you help us even the playing field and fight back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general-0805]
From Day One, this campaign has been powered by you. We’re so grateful for your support. As John says – thank YOU for fighting the good fight with us.
-Team Avlon

#
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide. **
[](http://trk.libertyledger.)
Is this something you can do? Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://trk.libertyledger.-KAFrqnGw)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider **[donating right now before this opportunity expires.](http://trk.libertyledger.-6DzF0EQA)**

Thank you in advance for standing with us against big abortion and equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

# _Primary Election Day 2024_
Dear Friends,
Polls are open for the last day in the 2024 primary election, and I wanted to take the quick opportunity to thank all of you for your support and prayers. We’ve knocked thousands of doors and made thousands of phone calls. We walked in dozens of parades and met with tens of conservative groups.
Felita and I have appreciated every effort and sincerely enjoyed the privilege of meeting so many people in the Second District. Here’s one of my favorite moments from the campaign trail: Felita lead a crowd of more than 120 in singing the National Anthem at a Matt Schlapp event in Topeka. It was a wonderful gathering of people who love the Lord and love our nation.

---
[](https://jeffkahrsforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16c344decd50f8373779db4a0&id=3c0ba7d46b&e=790c5fa456)
| If you haven’t voted yet, I humbly ask for your vote. Please encourage your friends and family to do the same. Here is a [link to find your polling place](https://jeffkahrsforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16c344decd50f8373779db4a0&id=bc55240164&e=790c5fa456).
I am committed to helping Trump implement his America First agenda and fighting for our shared conservative values in Congress.
Felita and I will always be so grateful for your encouragement, prayers, and support. Thank you!
---

I'm so proud that — with the governor's support and unwavering political courage — our movement has turned Minnesota into a model of what real progressive change looks like in our country.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1281%2E791427%2E1tCmTw)

Friends -
**As you may have heard by now, fellow Minnesotan and my friend, Governor Tim Walz, is Kamala Harris' pick for Vice President of the United States.**
First of all, I'd like to extend my heartfelt congratulations to Governor Walz.
Governor Walz is a veteran, a teachers union member, and a leader who has passed transformative progressive policies here in our home state, and I believe he is the best choice for our country's future and our movement's chances to defeat Donald Trump and JD Vance in November.
I've had the pleasure of working with the governor and organizing our movement together around a number of issues, and the success of landmark policies in Minnesota has shown they can and will work nationwide.
I'm so proud that — with the governor's support and unwavering political courage — our movement has turned Minnesota into a model of what real progressive change looks like in our country.
A state where no child is forced to go hungry, through our universal school meals program.
Where working people have some of the strongest labor protections in the nation, by establishing paid family and medical leave, guaranteeing paid sick days, and improving worker safety.
Where we combat the climate crisis head-on, moving away from fossil fuels and committing to a 100% clean energy standard by 2040.
Where the right to an abortion is protected by law, and women are free to make their own healthcare decisions.
_Where we don't send immigrants and refugees back to where they came from — we send them to Congress._
I'm confident that Kamala Harris and Tim Walz will not only defeat Donald Trump this November, they’ll lead the charge in enacting successful, popular, and progressive policies like Minnesota's at the federal level and implement them nationwide for years to come.
**I'm ready to fight alongside Kamala and Tim to get the job done. But our movement knows the only way we can do that is if we're all in the fight together.**

body:
Discover how Congressman Burlison championed our Second Amendment rights and more! Learn about his impactful work as a state legislator.
Peter
,

Thank you for continuing to be a part of our community and supporting Congressman Eric Burlison. Today, we want to share Eric's previous achievements and impactful work as a state legislator.

Eric's strong record of legislative accomplishments is a testament to his unwavering commitment to safeguarding our constitutional freedoms, a commitment that directly impacts and benefits our community.

Eric delivered several victories for protecting and expanding the Second Amendment rights of Missourians.

This included the Second Amendment Preservation Act, which ensured the state could not use resources to assist federal agents if their activities violated Missourians' Second Amendment rights. This law is a bold stand to protect our constitutional right to bear arms and prevent federal overreach.

Under Eric's leadership, Missouri now allows law-abiding citizens to carry a concealed firearm without a permit and expanded the castle doctrine. These laws ensure that our Second Amendment rights are respected and that individuals can protect themselves and their families without unnecessary government interference.

Eric worked to streamline the Amber Alert system through Haley's Law, ensuring that alerts are issued more promptly, thereby increasing the chances of recovering kidnapped children swiftly and safely.

To address rising healthcare costs, Eric passed medical tort reform, which reduced frivolous lawsuits and helped to make medical care more affordable for all Missourians.

These legislative achievements highlight Eric Burlison's unwavering dedication to protecting our rights and improving the quality of life for all Missourians. His work reflects his deep commitment to our values and vision for a prosperous future.

Kamala Harris just selected Tim Walz as her running mate, and as longtime backers, VoteVets could not be more proud of him. The Harris-Walz ticket has the FULL endorsement of VoteVets.
We were proud to endorse and put our own resources behind Tim in his first congressional race — back when no one thought the seat was winnable, Tim flipped it. Watching him win, time after time, even through down periods for Democrats, has been inspirational.
So have the last few weeks, as the rest of the country has seen what we have always seen in Tim — a decent, down to earth man who puts service to his country and his community above himself. Connecting across the aisle, but delivering on our values and our priorities. A high school football coach, a teacher, a neighbor, a National Guardsman (the highest ranking enlisted man to ever serve in government, and that is HUGE).
Tim Walz is one of the best, and Kamala Harris has the right person on her six. This is the most formidable ticket Democrats have had in years.
VoteVets will pour into the presidential race, running advertisements, turning out Veterans, and reaching folks other organizations can’t. With Tim Walz on the ticket, we’ve never been more excited to do the work.

Friends,
I couldn’t be happier that Kamala Harris has selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate in this election!
From one Tim to another — I’m so proud to support Tim Walz as the next Vice President of the United States, and I’m going to do everything I can to help send Kamala and Tim to the White House in November.
If you’re all in to hold the White House and defeat Trump this year, I hope you’ll split a donation between my campaign and the Harris-Walz ticket right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala]
Here’s one thing I always look out for: Do the people who know you best — those who’ve seen your work, experienced your leadership, and been around you over the long term — support you? And with Tim Walz, the answer is a resounding YES. After spending six terms in the U.S. House of Representatives serving a rural, red district, he was elected governor in 2018 by a margin of more than 11 percentage points — and then was re-elected in 2022. The people who know Tim Walz best...well, it’s clear they love him!
Beyond public office, Tim Walz has been serving our country for decades — he served 24 years in the Army National Guard and retired as a command sergeant major, and he served his community as a high school social studies teacher before serving in the House and as Governor.
As governor, Tim fought to enshrine the right to abortion in state law, set paid family and medical leave requirements for employees, and expanded background checks for gun purchases.
I have no doubt that as our next Vice President, Tim Walz will fight to protect and expand our rights, just as he has done as Governor of Minnesota.
I’m looking forward to working with my friends Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to win the White House, hold the Senate majority, and keep Virginia blue, and I hope you’re with me!
If you are, please split a donation of any amount between our campaigns to make sure we have the resources necessary to win big in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-kamala]

I know what it’s like to be a VP candidate. I’ve said before that it’s not just about helping the ticket be successful, but also about being a great friend — a candid confidant behind closed doors, and your running mate’s biggest cheerleader. I’m so glad that Kamala has a good friend by her side in Tim Walz!

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE August 6, 2024**
Contact: Kait Ahern — communications@yda.org **

---
**YOUNG DEMOCRATS OF AMERICA STATEMENT ON SELECTION OF MINNESOTA GOVERNOR TIM WALZ AS DEMOCRATIC VICE PRESIDENTIAL NOMINEE**
---
WASHINGTON, D.C. – Today the Young Democrats of America were excited to learn of Vice President Kamala Harris’ decision to select Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her 2024 running mate. Throughout his time in office, Walz has routinely fought to better the lives of Minnesotans— providing universal school meals, paid family leave, red flag gun laws, legalization of marijuana, and environmental protections. In 2023, Walz codified reproductive healthcare as a “fundamental right” in Minnesota by signing the Protect Reproductive Options Act into law. During his time in office, he also signed many LGBTQ+ protection bills into law, including the lifesaving "Trans Refuge" bill.
In the words of the Minnesota Young DFL president and national Young Democrats of America President Quentin Wathum-Ocama: “Governor Walz has nearly two decades of critical government experience, first as congressman and now as a two term governor who has presided over one of the most consequential and progressive legislative sessions in Minnesota history. His selection sends a clear message that a Harris-Walz administration is ready to deliver for the American people on day one.” We, the Young Democrats of America, could not be more enthusiastic with Vice President Harris’ decision. We look forward to electing Harris and Walz to their respective offices in November 2024.
---

If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.

**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
>From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from Morning Consult shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.

I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. Literally. My Democrat opponent has a lot of pressure on his back. His colleagues in the Senate, along with every left-wing news outlet in the country, are pinning their hopes of maintaining their majority on his reelection in Montana. " You'd think that with all the pressure to save his party's Senate majority, he'd embrace the candidacy of the newly minted Democrat nominee for president, Kamala Harris. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dream. With just 96 days until Election Day, we're still being outraised 3-1. I'm not sure that will ever change, but what is even more important to me and my team is knowing that we have the support of every Republican in the country as we move into the closing months of this race. . Hi there Peter, ____ If you're like me, it is easy to get overwhelmed by all the ways to study God's Word -- we have books, apps, and reading plans. It can even be hard to decide on where to go next! So I wanted to share an opportunity with you as you look to spend more time in God's Word and grow in your relationship with Him.

At _Today in the Word_ , our mission is to help believers grow closer to Christ through daily Bible study and real-life application. So we've developed daily devotionals written by the professors of Moody Bible Institute to help you stay in the Word, be inspired to walk with the Lord, and remain engaged with God's truth every day.

Our bite-sized devotionals -- delivered straight to your inbox every morning -- offer Scripture readings, encouraging messages, and practical applications to help you:
---
|
* Overcome life's challenges and find hope
* Deepen your faith and broaden your knowledge of Scripture
* Experience God's love in a rich and personal way
* Start your day with gospel-centered mindset

## Who is Tim Walz?
Minnesota Governor Tim Walz brings an extensive background to public service. He served a 24-year tenure in the National Guard as a non-commissioned officer. Likewise, Walz worked for 20 years as a public school teacher, where he also led his high school football team to win the Minnesota State Championship. Walz knows how to win in red districts, as he did for 12 years as a Congressman. And during his six years as Governor of Minnesota, Walz has consistently championed policies that benefit working families and promote social justice, despite only having a 1 seat majority in the legislature.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/872fa09f-9687-49f2-ad2f-a612db1ba244?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Tim Walz in the National Guard
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..fMuD2L94Q0gejCw3RBAj3-OtbjXfXAsVHNPygxJa8Ag?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147409169)
## Governor Walz Has A Stellar Record
Indeed, Governor Walz's accomplishments are impressive:
**Housing and Economic Development:** Secured $1 billion for housing initiatives. This is especially crucial as a shocking 27% of Americans are housing poor, i.e. they cannot afford to live where they live due to skyrocketing home prices.
**Gun Safety:** Enacted comprehensive gun safety laws because we know gun laws work. By contrast, JD Vance wants to further strip away gun safety protections.
**LGBTQ+ Protections:** Strengthened anti-discrimination protections for LGBTQ individuals. By contrast, JD Vance supports the fascist Project 2025, which calls to eliminate all legal protections for LGBTQ Americans.
**Reproductive Rights:** Passed legislation to protect reproductive rights in a post-Roe world. By contrast, JD Vance supports the overturn of Roe and continues to vote to ban IVF.
**Climate Action:** Committed Minnesota to achieving a carbon-neutral economy by 2030. During this climate crisis, this is the urgency we need on the federal level. By contrast, JD Vance supports the Project 2025 claim that climate change is a hoax.
**Child Poverty Reduction:** Governor Walz successfully cut child poverty by one-third in Minnesota. He instituted universal school meals without means testing, ensure all children in Minnesota are fed. That led to this iconic photo below. By contrast, JD Vance voted to end the child tax credit on the federal level, [which increased child poverty by more than 12%](https://substack.com/redirect/6663c62d-feb1-4c82-88ae-af26e6126fc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3a132237-6015-47a1-9d14-8baab599e2d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Education:** As a career public school teacher, Walz has been a champion for public school education and teachers, signing numerous [historic bills into law](https://substack.com/redirect/d04d0a37-ed0c-4b00-9b29-48803eb5481b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Bills that decrease the retirement age for teachers with full pension, raise salaries and collective bargaining rights, and reduce classroom sizes. By contrast, Vance voted against free school lunches, and instead supports private school vouchers instead of properly funding public education.
**Labor Rights:** It is no wonder labor unions love Walz as he's worked worked diligently to enhance labor protections. By contrast Vance opposes the PRO Act, remains silent as Republicans strip away protections and instead enacts child labor approvals.
**Cannabis legalization:** Walz's work to legalize cannabis is historic. Upon signing the legalization bill in 2023 he [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2a34953f-3728-4572-8edf-6e17b0010897?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> We've known for too long that prohibiting the use of cannabis hasn't worked. By legalizing adult-use cannabis, we're expanding our economy, creating jobs, and regulating the industry to keep Minnesotans safe. Legalizing adult-use cannabis and expunging or resentencing cannabis convictions will strengthen communities. This is the right move for Minnesota.
This is also a huge win for criminal justice reform, as Walz's bill automatically expunges non-felony cannabis offenses.
**Paid Sick Leave:** At a time when the United States is the only developed nation in the world that does not gaurantee paid sick leave on the federal level, [Walz implemented paid sick leave policies in Minnesota](https://substack.com/redirect/357d2e67-c4b6-4b17-9d48-02687aa6994b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). JD Vance, unsurprisingly, supports GOP initiatives to prevent paid leave from becoming a thing.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..fMuD2L94Q0gejCw3RBAj3-OtbjXfXAsVHNPygxJa8Ag?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147409169)
## Walz Is A Unifier
Tim Walz stands out for his pragmatic and inclusive approach. He was among the first politicians to call for an immediate ceasefire and the release of all hostages in Palestine and Israel. When addressing the Uncommitted Movement, Walz chose not to condemn or demonize them, but instead compassionately acknowledge their civic engagement and emphasized the importance of listening to diverse voices. [Walz said](https://substack.com/redirect/79dc6365-61a1-405c-8048-f2ac2140a005?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> These folks are civically engaged. This issue is a humanitarian crisis, they have every right to be heard. These folks are asking for a change in course, they're asking for more pressure to be put on.
Walz's roots and appeal in the Midwest are crucial for securing key states like Minnesota, Wisconsin, and Michigan--all critical to win in November. His authentic connection with working-class voters and his track record of effective governance make him a formidable candidate to bring the Midwest into the Democratic column.
And finally, supporting Walz also means making history with Peggy Flanagan. Flanagan is the current Lt. Governor of Virigina. With Walz's election to VP, Falanagan would have the chance to become the USA's first female Native American Governor. This would be a groundbreaking step forward in representation and inclusion.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..fMuD2L94Q0gejCw3RBAj3-OtbjXfXAsVHNPygxJa8Ag?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147409169)
## Conclusion
Tim Walz is not just a seasoned and effective leader; he is a compassionate and forward-thinking visionary. His policies and principles align with the values that can unite and propel America forward. Supporting Tim Walz for Vice President is a step towards a more just, inclusive, and prosperous nation.
You have my commitment to continue to hold politicians and media accountable. I support Walz for VP, but that does not mean I will ignore unjust policies. Indeed, we strengthen our democracy and country by voting for the person we feel best represents our values, and then holding them accountable to those values. Today is a good day for democracy. The right candidate, who supports the right policies embraced by We the People, got the nod. With less than 100 days until Election Day, we have a chance to make history.

Witchita Eagle: Kansas Supreme Court finds Kansans have no ‘fundamental right’ to vote [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=080624_1&amount=25]
Sit down before you read this, Team: The Kansas Supreme Court has ruled that voting is not a fundamental right protected by the Kansas Constitution.
It should go without saying, but this decision will likely weaken legal challenges to future voting restrictions in Kansas and make it easier for opponents of voting rights in their legislature to more aggressively pursue new anti-voting laws.
