**[NEW VIDEO](https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70969&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64084) Highlights Why Trump Endorsed Dahlstrom for Congress**
| **ANCHORAGE, AK** - In a [new video](https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70969&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64084), President Donald J. Trump highlighted why he endorsed Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom, the true conservative candidate in the race for Alaska's at-large congressional seat, for Congress.

President Trump reiterated that Dahlstrom has his **_"complete and total endorsement to be the next congresswoman from Alaska."_** President Trump said that he is **_"supporting Nancy because she is tough, smart, experienced, and a proven fighter"_** as well as that **_"she's also a very good person."_****_
_****[](https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70969&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64084)****_President Trump said:_****_

"Your current congresswoman, radical left Democrat Mary Peltola, supported Biden's disastrous energy policies, open border disaster, and government overreach that has really badly hurt the great state of Alaska. . Peltola puts Alaska last, and you will find we put Alaska first, and I always will put Alaska first."_****_

"Nancy Dahlstrom, on the other hand, will work with us to secure the border, create great jobs, lower taxes, stop inflation, support our always-under-siege Second Amendment, and promote American energy dominance. We'll start with ANWR - we'll get it done again."_**

Additionally, President Trump said that Dahlstrom **_"is great"_** and that he will **_"work for Alaska"_** with Dahlstrom **_"to make Alaska great again."_****_

Friend- I'm black, not braindead.

But the liberal media still said I was off my rocker for thinking I had a place in the party of Donald J. Trump.

They said there was no way the America First movement would ever consider supporting me.

They said the same thing in 2020 when I was running to become the first black Lt. Governor of North Carolina, and sure enough they were wrong.

I won.

But as of this morning, the race is nearly tied. They have all the money & all the manpower needed to put this race out of reach so what happens in the next few minutes will make or break our one and only chance to deal Kamala Harris her first humiliating defeat since launching her campaign for President.

Ballots will soon be in the mail and this race will be won or lost in the next few hours.

Our work is all interconnected, and I know that with President Kamala Harris and Vice President Tim Walz, we will keep pushing forward.
Peter, the future of the Democratic party is a bright one – _and a progressive one. _
**I’m feeling so fired up by the news that Kamala Harris has selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate! **
He has all the makings of a wonderful second-in-command: he is unwavering in his principles, dedicated to public service, and an excellent leader. (And on a personal note, it doesn’t hurt that he and I have both been social studies teachers!)
Although Minnesota may be hundreds of miles away, Governor Walz has advocated for his constituents in a way that should make Vermonters proud. We share many issues and priorities, from empowering rural communities to tackling food insecurity and protecting our LGBTQ+ friends and neighbors.
Our work is all interconnected, and I know that with President Kamala Harris and Vice President Tim Walz, we will keep pushing forward. name: The Bolt News Flash
subject: Shapiro Claims Ignorance on Staff Allegations
body:
The Bolt: New breaking news from Broad + Liberty | | | |
---
| | |
---
| **NEW:**_**Shapiro claims he didn’t know of sexual misconduct allegations against his staffer until months later**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0840eb88d8&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "Gov. Josh Shapiro (D) is now claiming that after his Secretary of Legislative Affairs had been accused by a subordinate of sexual misconduct and harassment in the workplace in 2023, he did not find out about either the accusations or the resulting investigation until “months after” the events.

The new revelation, stemming from a statement made by Shapiro’s spokesperson to the _New York Times_ , raises a fresh set of questions, especially given that the governor met with a number of female state senators soon after news of the scandal broke to reassure them that his office took workplace sexual harassment seriously.

Two Republican state senators reacted to the new line of defense with astonishment, essentially saying the argument was hard if not impossible to believe. Meanwhile, a request for comment was not returned from numerous female Democratic senators who had expressed concern with Shapiro’s office had handled the issue.

The original matter dates back to the earliest weeks of the Shapiro administration — nearly all of February and the first week of March 2023..."

---

### _Documents undermine Shapiro’s claims of thorough investigation into top advisor’s misconduct allegations_
A document obtained by _Broad + Liberty_ suggests that Gov. Josh Shapiro’s office may have been providing legal advice to his then-Secretary of Legislative Affairs while simultaneously investigating the official for workplace harassment claims made by one of his subordinates in March 2023...

For 35 months, we've been campaigning hard, working to earn you support and trust.
I'm in this race because we share a common vision for the district, that Northern Michigan and the UP can progress and be better.
drbob.me/mivote [drbob.me/mivote]
Today is Election Day. With you in my corner, there's nothing we can't achieve. Rise up, MI01!
YOUR VOTING INFO [drbob.me/mivote]
Friends,
Thank you for being on this journey with me. My goal in running for Congress is to take all of our voices to DC, so you have representation that cares, representation that has lived in the district for four decades, and someone who will push concrete policies that make life better for everyone.
We are fighting, not against our neighbors, but for a cause - for our families, freedoms and futures.
No matter your background, age, gender, identity, or income, you deserve leadership that listens.
I'm listening. I hear you.
In fact, we've extended my call hours today to be available to you should you have any questions about my campaign or platform. Every constituent counts. You can book a call right now on my calendar at drbob.me/mivote. [drbob.me/mivote]
My team is also helping voters find their precincts and transporting people to the polls.
Friends, this election is so important. It determines who will be on the ballot with our future president - who will fight for affordable housing, childcare, education and healthcare for all, especially reproductive rights.
Who will fight for a labor revolution, and an economic system that works for everyone, not just the ultra wealthy.
That's why I'm in this race. It will be the honor of my life to represent you.
Thank you for your continued support, generosity, and loyalty. I cannot do this without you.
Today, I'm humbly asking for your vote. Can I count on you?
Grateful,
Bob

body:
This isn't about me. It never has been.
#

Hi friend,
If you have a minute, I wanted to send you a note about the last couple of weeks.
I never expected to find myself in this position.
I’m the son of two police officers who lived my dream of becoming a U.S. Navy pilot and a NASA astronaut.
My wife Gabby was always the elected official in our family, until her career in Congress was taken from her by a gunman.
I stepped up to run for the U.S. Senate because I saw an opportunity to make a difference and serve my state and my country in a new way. As you know, we had two hard-fought campaigns in 2020 and 2022. You had my back every step of the way, and because of it, we were able to flip this seat and protect it just two years later. Representing Arizona in the Senate is the most important job I’ve ever had.
But this isn't about me. It never has been.
It’s about the future of our country. It’s about whether our kids grow up with fewer rights than the generations before them. It’s about whether our economy creates opportunity for everyone, or is rigged for billionaires. It’s about whether we strengthen our alliances, or see them shredded.
That’s the choice our country faces right now: move forward with Vice President Harris and Governor Tim Walz, or be dragged backward by Donald Trump and JD Vance.
Tim has years of experience representing Minnesota both in the House of Representatives, where he served with Gabby, and as Minnesota’s governor. In that time, he has shown up time and time again for working families and I know he’ll continue that work in the White House.
Gabby and I are going to do everything we can to make Kamala Harris and Tim Walz the next president and vice president of the United States, and I’m asking you to join us.

Tim Walz as her pick for Vice President! This is a crucial time to ramp up our efforts, with just three months until Election Day. = Here’s what I know: Kamala Harris and Gov. Tim Walz will get things done for the American people. From championing the kitchen table issues most important to families to fighting to end gun violence to leading the charge to protect and expand abortion rights, they will bring Marylanders and Americans together to do big things. name: Jill Stein 2024
subject: The Democrats subvert democracy... again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Kamala’s party is democratic in name only.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_subvert_democracy&n=1)
---
Peter, In all the hoopla surrounding Joe Biden handing off the baton to Kamala Harris, it seems like no one in the corporate mainstream media is talking about an uncomfortable reality: **this is the third presidential election in a row where the so-called Democratic Party has effectively denied voters any meaningful choice in the primaries.** We’ve started calling it the anti-Democratic Party due to the Dems’ relentless attempts to kick Greens and others off the ballot, infiltrate and sabotage their competitors, and use a whole arsenal of dirty tricks to keep voters like you from having a real choice. But as if that weren’t bad enough, DNC elites have made an art of subverting their own primaries to deny their own voters a real choice. In 2016, emails from DNC insiders published by Wikileaks revealed how the party used its influence to sabotage Bernie Sanders (while urging their powerful media contacts to “elevate” Donald Trump, who they saw as a preferred opponent). Between the subterfuge and the outsized voting power of party insiders known as “superdelegates”, they never gave Sanders a chance. Then in 2020 when Sanders was gaining momentum in the primaries, it only took a few calls from party elites to make a crowded field of centrists all drop out and line up behind Biden. In the 2024 cycle, anti-Democratic Party insiders insisted that Biden would be the candidate and no real primary could be allowed. Several state parties refused to put any candidate other than Biden on the ballot (sound familiar?). **And now Biden has handed the nomination to his hand-picked successor - all without having to get a single voter involved.** The DNC elites’ hand-picked candidate is the same Kamala Harris who dropped out of the 2020 primaries due to plummeting in the polls before a single vote was cast. Harris’ record promoting mass incarceration and her corporate-friendly agenda may have flopped with voters, but **in the anti-Democratic Party, it’s not the voters who decide - it’s the party insiders.** **While the anti-democratic duopoly’s candidates are backed by billionaires and political elites, we refuse to take money from wealthy special interests and rely 100% on grassroots supporters like you to power this campaign.[Please pitch in whatever you can today to support our fight for real democracy!](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_subvert_democracy&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_subvert_democracy&n=3 "DONATE ") [DONATE ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_subvert_democracy&n=4)
---
**While the Dems preach ad nauseam about how they’re “saving democracy”, in reality they’ve been waging war on democracy - even inside their own party.** Underneath the rhetoric, their actions have been clearly aimed at one thing: preserving the power and privilege of party elites above all else. The anti-Democratic Party plays a key role in maintaining the corporate duopoly’s stranglehold on our government. While over 60% of US voters say the two-party system is failing so badly to represent us that we need a new party, the anti-Democrats are working hard to make sure they don’t have that choice. Like the Biden campaign, the Harris campaign is a front for empire and oligarchy, presenting only the illusion of choice. That’s why **it’s so critical that we continue leading the fight for real democracy with a campaign that’s powered by small donors and grassroots volunteers.** **We’re building a movement to revive our democracy with a full spectrum of reforms to empower the people** , including ranked-choice voting, proportional representation, full public campaign financing to get big money out of politics, and much more. [See our platform on democracy for more](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_subvert_democracy&n=5) on our plan to bring real democracy to the US. Thank you for everything you do to grow the movement for people, planet, and peace! In solidarity and gratitude, Team Jill Stein

We will do everything we can to elect him and Kamala Harris in 90 days.
#

Have you heard the news?
Vice President Kamala Harris just announced Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.
[**Election Day is approaching rapidly, and it’s up to us to throw our full support behind Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. So please, help us fuel the Harris-Walz campaign by making a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240806-1-30&t=1&akid=8657%2E3935704%2ENLNOA1)

Vice President Harris has been a strong gun safety champion in the White House, from breaking a nearly 30 year logjam on gun safety legislation by supporting the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ , to leading the federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
Governor Walz is an incredibly strong gun safety champion as well, and we’re committed to doing everything we can to make him our next vice president. As a responsible gun owner himself, Governor Walz understands that we need to enact commonsense gun safety legislation to keep our communities safe from preventable gun violence.
Gabby and Tim’s friendship and shared commitment to saving lives from gun violence goes back to 2007, where they met as freshman members of the US House of Representatives. During his time in the House, Governor Walz voted to expand background checks and to fund CDC research into gun violence. As governor, he passed significant gun safety legislation in Minnesota with a one-seat majority, including a background checks and extreme risk protection order bill.
We need your support today. Gabby has been traveling to battleground states across the country to make sure voters know about our endorsed gun safety candidates. Now that the Harris-Walz ticket is official, Gabby now needs to share the important message that Vice President Harris and Governor Walz are the only ones that can get the job done when it comes to defeating the gun lobby and saving lives.

body:
Tim Walz! It’s almost too good to be true.

But sometimes nice guys come out on top.

I got to know Tim in Congress, where I sat next to him on the House
Veterans Affairs committee for six years. We became good friends and close
colleagues. I saw him fight for veterans, tenaciously winning resources
and accountability for those who’ve put their lives on the line for
America. And I watched him represent his rural Minnesota district with the
kind of strength, common sense and empathy that set him apart from other
members of the House.

As Governor of Minnesota, he has been able to codify abortion rights,
implement background checks for private gun sales, legalize marijuana,
pass paid family leave, restore voting rights and invest more than $1
billion in affordable housing.

And before any of this, he was a high school teacher, football coach and a
24-year veteran of the army national guard.

He also happens to be a terrific dad and husband — there isn’t a
conversation I’ve had with him where he doesn’t bring up his kids, always
beaming with pride.

We’re lucky to have someone like Tim Walz in public life. And I’m
absolutely thrilled that Vice President Kamala Harris has chosen him to be
her running mate.

I’m proud to endorse Kamala Harris and Tim Walz for president and vice president!
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240806-4177-footer&t=1&akid=4177%2E420207%2EllG_Hy)
Peter,
**It’s official: I’m proud to endorse Kamala Harris and Tim Walz for president and vice president!** Together, I’m confident the Harris-Walz ticket will continue building momentum, bring together the entire Democratic coalition, and defeat Trump-Vance this November.
[**If you’re as excited as I am to hold the White House, take back the House, and keep advancing our progressive agenda, will you split a $3 donation between the Harris-Walz campaign and mine today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240806-1.ZOAjRz&refcode=em20240806-4177&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4177%2E420207%2EllG_Hy)
I’ve seen firsthand the palpable energy and excitement surrounding Kamala Harris’ candidacy, and her selection of Tim Walz as her running mate will further grow this enthusiasm and advance a strong working class agenda that speaks to voters across America.
Governor Walz brings to the ticket a proven ability to repeatedly and consistently win in rural and swing districts, and a record of implementing a **strong, progressive agenda** that provides opportunity and freedom for all.
As Governor, Tim Walz worked with advocates, voters, and the legislature to pass many progressive priorities like **paid family and medical leave** , protecting **abortion rights** , historic investments in **affordable housing** , strengthening **labor rights** , defending **voting rights** , and enforcing **universal background checks**.
I am grateful to Vice President Harris for this outstanding pick for the American people, and I know the Harris-Walz agenda will continue to mobilize voters across the country to victory in November with a bold, popular vision that focuses on the pressing needs of poor and working people.
[**I’m ready to get to work and elect Kamala Harris President and Tim Walz Vice President of the United States. This is just one poll — and we still have a long way to go until the election. But we’re taking this win as we gear up for the home stretch. They said the same thing in 2020 when I was running to become the first black Lt. Governor of North Carolina, and sure enough they were wrong.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104585/images/YYY.jpg]
Michael B. Moore Applauds Harris-Walz Ticket, Predicts Victory in November

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: August 6, 2024
CONTACT: Alissa Holmes, Director of Communications | Alissa@Michaelbmoore.com | (843) 695-9878

CHARLESTON, SC — Michael B. Moore, Democratic candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District, responded enthusiastically to Vice President Kamala Harris's selection of Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate:

“Governor Walz, a former teacher and distinguished member of the Army National Guard, has long championed women, working families, and veterans in Minnesota. Together with Vice President Harris, they represent strong leadership and a steadfast commitment to improving American lives. Their vision and experience make them the winning ticket this November. I am confident they will tackle critical issues facing working families in South Carolina and across the country, including women's reproductive freedom and healthcare broadly, economic opportunity, and the environment. Their dedication to upholding democracy and protecting the rights and freedoms of all Americans is unwavering. I am proud to support their campaign and believe deeply in the leadership they will bring to our nation.”

Last month, Moore was among the first Democrats urging President Biden to step aside and pave the way for a new nominee against former President Donald Trump. He continues to campaign vigorously in a tightly contested race against Rep. Nancy Mace in South Carolina’s newly redrawn 1st District.

A citizen candidate and forward-thinking business executive with nearly four decades of private sector experience, Michael B. Moore has held leadership roles at Fortune 500 companies, entrepreneurial ventures, and nonprofit organizations. Most recently, he was the founding president of the International African American Museum in Charleston, South Carolina.

Michael comes from a long line of pioneering public servants – most notably his great-great-grandfather, Civil War hero and Reconstruction-era Congressman Robert Smalls, who held the same seat almost 150 years ago.

After graduating from Syracuse University, Michael earned an MBA from Duke University and received an honorary Doctorate in Public History from Dickinson College. He is a devoted husband to his wife, Karla; the loving father of four sons: David, Lucas, Israel, and Robert; and a new grandfather to Sasha.

name: Taking the Hill
subject: NYT Shapiro-Obama | Veepstakes| Comics for Kamala
body:
https://www.takingthehillpac.com/ [https://www.takingthehillpac.com/]
Friend,
Wanted to share with you this great New York Times piece on Josh Shapiro and the veepstakes. The article chronicles Governor Shapiro's relationship with President Obama, and how it has developed over the past two decades.
"In 2007, despite Mrs. Clinton's front-runner status for the Democratic nomination, Mr. Shapiro endorsed Mr. Obama for president, impressed by his promises to wind down the war in Iraq, said Mr. Murphy, who recalled discussing the decision with Mr. Shapiro."
“They became active campaigners on Mr. Obama’s behalf. Mr. Shapiro also drafted an open letter to the state’s Jewish community on behalf of Mr. Obama, after incendiary statements made by Mr. Obama’s former pastor had surfaced.
After Mr. Obama won the White House, Mr. Shapiro kept in touch with him and his political team.”
“Mr. Murphy, who went on to serve as an acting secretary of the Army in the Obama administration in 2016, sometimes played basketball with Mr. Obama. He recalled Mr. Shapiro’s name coming up.”
“Every time I would see him, he’s like, ‘How’s my guy Josh doing?’” Mr. Murphy said of his interactions with Mr. Obama. “All those folks in Obama’s orbit have a real soft spot for Josh Shapiro for doing what he did when it was not popular.”
As you all know, the veepstakes are heating up, with rumor noting the decision is down to between Governor Shapiro and Governor Walz, with Vice President Harris traveling to Philadelphia tomorrow for a rally to kick-off her tour through 2024's battleground states with her newly named Vice Presidential nominee.
Lastly, I wanted to invite you to join, attend, and contribute to Comics for Kamala tonight at 8pm! Join a star-studded cast of comics fighting the good fight for our democratic nominee!

I've served as Governor of Minnesota for long enough to understand what politics is all about: _making things a little easier for folks._
We protected access to abortion, capped the cost of insulin, cut taxes for working families, established universal background checks for gun purchases. It's common-sense stuff.
**But these other guys are just plain _weird_.**
Donald Trump and JD Vance are selling a twisted version of freedom where far-right extremists can invade your doctor's office. Take it from a small-town guy: they know nothing about what working families need.
**Kamala and I believe in a different kind of freedom.** The freedom to keep communities safe from gun violence. The freedom to give every child a chance at getting ahead. The freedom to trust women to decide when and how they start a family.
_Now, I'm ready to get out there and fight for our future -- are you with me?_

**_Mike Braun's Statement on Kamala Harris' Selection of Tim Walz as her Running Mate_** **INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (August 6, 2024)** – Indiana Republican nominee for Governor, Mike Braun, issued a statement upon the selection of Tim Walz as Kamala Harris' running mate.
_**Statement from Indiana Republican Nominee for Governor Mike Braun:**_
---
"As Governor, Tim Walz signed radical bills giving illegal immigrants driver’s licenses and state-funded health care, allowed unlimited abortion up until the moment of birth, allowed boys to compete in girls’ sports, and is wrong for our country. I am proud to support Donald Trump, J.D. Vance, and the Republican ticket who have solutions to fix the problems created by the Biden-Harris administration which will Make America Great Again.” _###_

Friends ,
I've been traveling all across Ohio, meeting with families and communities on a county fair tour this week, but I wanted to take a moment to share some exciting news with you.
It’s official!
Minnesota Governor and fellow county fair enthusiast Tim Walz has been chosen as our running mate for Vice President Harris.

We've got our full ticket now, and I couldn't be more excited to help elect the Harris-Walz team and kick Jim Jordan out of Congress!
The path to the White House and the House majority runs right through Ohio. With leaders like Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, we've got a winning message focused on expanding women's reproductive rights and stopping another rise of a second despotic Trump administration.
Governor Walz has done incredible work in Minnesota, demonstrating what compassionate and effective leadership looks like.
He's passed groundbreaking bills to support children and families, including free school lunches for all students and significant investments in education.
This is the kind of leadership that prioritizes the well-being of our communities over corporate profits and extremist agendas.
Kamala Harris, Governor Walz, and I are committed to delivering real results for hard-working families nationwide. With Harris and Walz heading to the Oval Office, I’ll be right by their side, ready to defeat the most extreme and dangerous member of Congress. Like the sound of that plan? Support our campaign today and help us make it happen. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240806_walz_vp_link1]
In stark contrast, Donald Trump and JD Vance have centered their campaign on a dangerous and creepy agenda, focused on controlling our bodies and dismantling our freedoms and government as we know it.
They have shown time and again that they are more interested in spreading fear and division than in helping everyday Americans.
Jim Jordan is supporting them every step of the way.
Just as Tim Walz did in his first run for Congress, we will flip this red seat blue and inspire a generation of new leaders dedicated to progress and community-driven change.
We are both committed to fighting for policies that uplift working families, support our kids, and protect our rights.
I gotta tell ya, I am so excited about Walz joining the ticket. He understands rural America, so I know he will be great for my constituents who have felt ignored, forgotten, and left behind.
Ohio deserves representatives who will champion progress, not drag us backward.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90330638/490159215/-1706349631?sourceid=1054504&refcode=WTEFET18_20240806_Kamala-EL_ALL_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmY5ODhlMC0yMTU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w1304hufLjXnY1Gx20EnVRcMGLandxPkoIgNflidN7s=) Peter, EMILYs List was founded on the principle that electing women from the bottom of the ballot to the top changes every aspect of American politics for the better.

**And this year, we have the opportunity to elect an EMILYs List woman at the very top. **

Our choice to endorse Vice President **Kamala Harris** as the next president of the United States was an easy one — _we've stood with her for the last 20 years_ as she served at the local, state and national level.

EMILYs List first endorsed Vice President Harris when she ran for San Francisco district attorney in 2003, and we've been with her every step of the way since — from California attorney general, to U.S. senator, to vice president, and now to president.

A testimony YEARS in the making| | | [](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=a5ba552f837e4554ba642f19b8502658&_e=uCAG8BoAMjagCwPhKAUfx-6CAbOmKZJmi4hagk7gTRZ3eBvMvDwP0nOCHwAYYnG0GTCm5OXiLHkOy4MeBnmc-2Dn8W0xjSy5zSwwR9-G1azghy-8LV8pG3dijgnHkKH8W4m80SKs79g7uT1uZ0prw8RFawbm0sUlKUljspWiCqVuGATeKZfTc6pKUlovnKjrRxp36xqM-95lUe-6hEbyf3c7hubqy6-Xl4WIWxK1gd4Ve476hwWWGitC2Sd_wkJOhP-AZ29-q1aUMxC3avf2HFpmhPNVvvHMXNeuVWGtAerSbZtzEORSLS6Ubjm8PvO-)

Dear Friend,
---
This week's Testimony Tuesday is a miracle years in the making. Back in 2021, a young woman attended our revival in Great Falls, Montana. She told us her dad was in a coma, and that the hospital tried to put him on hospice three separate times. But she hadn't given up on her dad, and she believed that God wasn't done with his life. She continued to pray, and when Let Us Worship came to town, she called on our prayer team. We prayed over her dad at his bedside. The Lord answered our prayers and HE. WOKE. UP. Last weekend, at our Kingdom to the Capitol revival in Montana, that same young woman told us the whole story—her dad was there with her!!! Listen to her tell the story, but be warned, you may need a box of tissues before it's over! _**WATCH THE TESTIMONY⬇︎⬇︎⬇︎**_
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=a5ba552f837e4554ba642f19b8502658&_e=uCAG8BoAMjagCwPhKAUfx-6CAbOmKZJmi4hagk7gTRZ3eBvMvDwP0nOCHwAYYnG0GTCm5OXiLHkOy4MeBnmc-2Dn8W0xjSy5zSwwR9-G1azghy-8LV8pG3dijgnHkKH8W4m80SKs79g7uT1uZ0prw8RFawbm0sUlKUljspWiCqWKyA9TlswzBuY2QDEP0nKBp8-LoODn6bPy-Y5wfKixsaBTTGSQDt82XzIB1R4NlqxYHnPCselYzQCaF0_Y2-NlD-YL3BAwHeVQopt48P5JwIDRehnHpciPaAh87o-XAie3VCDmyt_WH2OCc2yDh7UF)
---
We serve a God of POWER!! The same power that raised Jesus from the dead is alive today! And we serve a God of MIRACLES. The enemy will lie and spread the false rumor that the time for miracles has passed. But I know the truth. If you've followed the Let Us Worship movement for any amount of time, you know the truth too. We've SEEN miracles, and we share the handiwork of God with the masses because we want to testify to His power today, not just of the past.
---
Till All Hear,
---
---
Sean

| | Peter, we have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to defeat the MAGA agenda and elect a President Kamala Harris and Vice President Tim Walz in November. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz provide a clear and stark contrast to the regressive vision Donald Trump has for this country. | Hi Peter,

We hope you’ve been having a great summer so far! The heat hasn’t slowed down Ami one bit — he’s been busy at events throughout Sacramento County, and has continued to deliver for our region.
| | **_Delivering for Sacramento County_
→** Ami was recently joined by several other local leaders to celebrate a [$25 million federal grant for the SouthEast Connector Project](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90333251/490168731/463244462?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240805_EN_Newsletter_3MO_BeraHQ_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMzA1YmU0ZS0yNzU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dw0wnH9u4RKvECQjDCCdv33GmoJ-KegotvvefrA6u2w=&emci=d005be4e-2754-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=d305be4e-2754-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=32394541). This project will reduce traffic accidents and improve safety along this corridor that connects Elk Grove to El Dorado County.
**→** Ami also helped to secure [$76.8 million for SacRT!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90333252/490168732/1779384871?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240805_EN_Newsletter_3MO_BeraHQ_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMzA1YmU0ZS0yNzU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dw0wnH9u4RKvECQjDCCdv33GmoJ-KegotvvefrA6u2w=&emci=d005be4e-2754-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=d305be4e-2754-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=32394541) This will allow Sacramento’s public transportation system to replace aging buses with state-of-the-art hydrogen fuel cell buses, along with a zero-emission maintenance facility. This project will create jobs, improve local air quality, and help SacRT achieve its goal of converting its fleet to entirely zero emission vehicles by 2028. _**Continuing to Address the Cost of Health Care**_
**→** Joining colleagues from both sides of the aisle, Ami reintroduced the [Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90333253/490168733/1598734722?source=EM_NBI_AB_20240805_EN_Newsletter_3MO_BeraHQ_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMzA1YmU0ZS0yNzU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dw0wnH9u4RKvECQjDCCdv33GmoJ-KegotvvefrA6u2w=&emci=d005be4e-2754-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=d305be4e-2754-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=32394541)This bipartisan legislation will streamline the prior authorization process under Medicare Advantage, allowing seniors to get the care they need and helping health care providers put patients over paperwork. _**Working Towards Stability in Asia**_
**→** Earlier this summer, Ami was part of a bipartisan Congressional delegation to India where he met with His Holiness, the 14th Dalai Lama, in Dharamshala, India. Following the meeting and a felicitation ceremony hosted by the Central Tibetan Administration, Ami issued the following statement, “It was a great honor to meet with His Holiness during my bipartisan Congressional delegation to India. I was inspired by the Dalai Lama’s message of compassion, forgiveness, and the importance of embracing our shared humanity. I am proud to stand with my colleagues in our unwavering support of the Tibetan people in their pursuit of freedom and self-determination.”
---

As we approach a critical election in just a few short months, it’s never been more important to stand up for decency in our politics. Thanks for your support!

— Bera Headquarters

Vice President Harris has chosen Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate! | Derek,

The announcement we’ve been waiting for is here:**Vice President Harris has chosen Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate!**

[Can I count on you to rush a donation to invest in winning Wisconsin in November? We need to raise $42,198 today to send a message that we’re ready to win a tight election that will determine the future of our country for generations to come!](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2262?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20240806_FR_WalzVP_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_NA&t=5&akid=6841%2E1827488%2Ed3zG4U)

Together, this is a formidable team that I know will defeat Donald Trump and J.D. Vance in November. Vice President Harris and Gov. Walz bring the experience, vision, and determination needed to overcome the challenges we face. Unlike Trump-Vance, they will bring decency, integrity, and progressive leadership to the White House.

Walz has proven himself to be a bold and transformative leader for Minnesota and the nation. As former educators, Tim and I believe in doing what’s best for kids, leading with kindness, empathy, and respect, and working hard to get good things done for the people we serve. Those are exactly the kind of Midwestern values and qualities that will make Tim a great Vice President.

Under his leadership, Minnesota has become a safe haven for the trans community, affirmed abortion as a fundamental right, and removed barriers to access. Walz has championed paid family and medical leave, tax rebates for working families, environmental protections, legalizing recreational marijuana, and the elimination of parental fees for families with kids on Medicaid.

Unlike the extreme right-wing agenda pushed by Trump and Vance, Walz' vision and actions demonstrate his commitment to equity, progress, and the well-being of all Americans. Supporting Harris-Walz means backing a future where freedoms are protected, democracy is strengthened, and folks have the opportunity to succeed – now let’s go win the darn thing!

[Chip in now as a founding General Election donor.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2262?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20240806_FR_WalzVP_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_NA&t=6&akid=6841%2E1827488%2Ed3zG4U)

Onward,

Tony Evers

Hi Peter, Today marks 59 years since the landmark Voting Rights Act was signed, giving long-overdue voter protections to Black Americans. The 1960s may be bygone, but the Jim Crow-era voting bans aimed to disenfranchise communities of color remain prevalent in our nation, albeit under a different guise. From manipulating our voting maps to dilute the voting power of communities of color, rolling back mail-in and early voting options often utilized by many voters of color, and weaponizing incarceration status to permanently deny voting rights based on criminal convictions — **Americans are still facing unethical voter suppression tactics that aim to silence voices at the ballot box and beyond.** I’ve said it once, and I’ll continue to say it again and again: **Voting is a fundamental right of citizenship, and every American should have an equal voice in our democracy.** I’m in Congress fighting for a country where democracy can flourish and where the fundamental right to vote is protected for all Americans — and I will continue to once re-elected. [But, Peter, democracy is nothing without teamwork. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Hi Peter, Today marks 59 years since the landmark Voting Rights Act was signed, giving long-overdue voter protections to Black Americans. The 1960s may be bygone, but the Jim Crow-era voting bans aimed to disenfranchise communities of color remain prevalent in our nation, albeit under a different guise. From manipulating our voting maps to dilute the voting power of communities of color, rolling back mail-in and early voting options often utilized by many voters of color, and weaponizing incarceration status to permanently deny voting rights based on criminal convictions — Americans are still facing unethical voter suppression tactics that aim to silence voices at the ballot box and beyond. I’ve said it once, and I’ll continue to say it again and again: Voting is a fundamental right of citizenship, and every American should have an equal voice in our democracy. # Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
---
|
---
|
## Note from The Host Committee
---
| We are only **13** days away from the Democratic National Convention! We have an exciting next two weeks ahead! Be on the lookout for news about the Host Committee’s work as we wrap our journey to the DNC.
---
|
---
|
## “Welcome to Chicago” High School Art Competition
---
| Last week, the Host Committee announced the winners of the “Welcome to Chicago” High School Art competition. **Sarah Al-Shawabkeh** , a junior at William Howard Taft High School, was selected as the first place winner and will have her design featured on Democratic National Convention memorabilia. Sarah’s work was selected by a panel of judges who reviewed artwork submitted by high school students from across the Chicago area. The Host Committee is proud to announce the following students will also have their designs displayed at convention events: **Brigid O’Malley,** Chicago High School of Agricultural Science – 2nd Place **Jairo Camacho** , Lincoln Park High School – 3rd Place **Aniyah Coleman** , Walter Payton College Prep – 4th Place

## Art Competition Reception
Outstanding high school artists were invited to celebrate their work at [Gallery Guichard](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=435649fe6e&e=e789b9d47e) in the historic Bronzeville Community. Mayor Brandon Johnson stopped by to thank the students for their incredible talent and efforts. Students, parents, and teachers, and guests were treated to delicious catering from [Pier 31 Restaurant](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8032b9a73d&e=e789b9d47e) sponsored by [Grubhub](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e09cf139eb&e=e789b9d47e).

## Volunteer Update
---
| Over 30,000 individuals completed an application or joined our waitlist! We couldn’t be more thrilled by the record-breaking enthusiasm for the 2024 Democratic National Convention. Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate everyone who completed an application with a volunteer role.For approved applicants who applied before July 20th, shifts have been released. Make sure to choose your shifts as soon as possible, shifts are filling up quickly! Please direct questions to [volunteers@chicago2024.com.](mailto:volunteers@chicago2024.com?subject=&body=)
---
|
---
|
## NABJ DNC Fireside Chat
---
| | | | | | | | | | | Last week, Chicago 2024 Host Committee Executive Director **Christy George** and Senior Advisor **Keiana Barrett** joined Democratic Party Chair **Jaime Harrison** and Democratic National Convention Chair **Minyon Moore** for a fireside chat moderated by Choose Chicago Board Chair **Glenn Eden**. They spoke with members of the National Association of Black Journalists Political Task Force at [Hue Chicago](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=16c0f90d26&e=e789b9d47e) in the South Loop neighborhood.
---
|
---
|
## Choose Chicago’s DNC Guides
---
| Looking to make plans during the convention? Check out Choose Chicago’s [eleven DNC guides](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=bbf32ce462&e=e789b9d47e) aimed to help visitors discover the vibrancy and diversity of the city. The guides highlight different communities such as LGBTQ+, family friendly, Black culture, Hispanic/Latino culture, and Asian culture as well as insights to music, food and family friendly activities!
---
[Learn More Here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e1514ae612&e=e789b9d47e)
| Host Committee Executive Director **Christy George** and Choose Chicago Interim President and CEO **Richard Gamble** joined Fox 32’s Good Day Chicago to discuss the economic impact of the DNC and the release of DNC Guides.

| Flying into the convention? We have the perfect offer for you!
Until August 28th, select airport vendors at Chicago’s Midway and O’Hare airports will offer 10% off if you show your DNC credential or show this flyer on your phone.

## DNC Brings Business Opportunities to Chicago Vendors
---
| If you're planning a meeting or event during the convention, you can find your next venue, caterer, decorator, or vendor using the Vendor Directory! If you're a vendor, but not in the directory yet, there’s still time to put your business in the spotlight! Complete the [Vendor Interest Form](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1275e08db6&e=e789b9d47e) and our team will carefully review your submission and add your business to the[ Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=adc37fa3ac&e=e789b9d47e) or[ Venue Map](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f0053630c7&e=e789b9d47e).
For questions about vendors, please email [vendors@chicago2024.com](mailto:vendors@chicago2024.com), and for venue inquiries, please email [venues@chicago2024.com](mailto:venues@chicago2024.com).
---
|
---
|
## Chicago Convention Trivia
---
| Congratulations to **Carlos Gamez** who was the first to correctly respond to last week’s question! The first nationally televised political convention was the 1952 Republican National Convention in Chicago!
**This week’s question** : The 2024 Democratic National Convention is the second DNC hosted in the United Center. What are the only two venues that have hosted multiple DNCs in Chicago?
Email [press@chicago2024.com](mailto:press@chicago2024.com?subject=Convention%20Trivia%20Answer&body=) with your answer.
---
|
---
|
## 77 Spotlight
---
| | | | | | | | | | | This week, our spotlights are spread around the city with a North Side, West Side, and South Side neighborhood.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **Portage Park** is famous for previously hosting the Pan-American Games in 1959 and the U.S. Olympic swimming trials in 1972![Schoolhouse Kitchen + Studio](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=fcc337a2af&e=e789b9d47e) hosts kids cooking parties, summer camps, and cooking classes for adults!
---
|
---
| 📷 Victor Powell
---
| Established in 1986, [The National Veterans Art Museum](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f1a2690ba0&e=e789b9d47e) displays exhibits based on experiences, healing, and transformation.
[Ballet Folklorico de Chicago](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ef76792dfa&e=e789b9d47e) provides cultural and dance instruction on the North side of Chicago. Make sure to follow them and watch them [perform](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=8c2d4ed3c8&e=e789b9d47e) around the city!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| 📷 Ronnie Frey
---
| | **East Garfield Park** houses the Garfield Park Conservatory, one of the biggest conservatories in the nation!
Go check out the [Garfield Park Field House](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=25fb267b5e&e=e789b9d47e), more popularly known as the “Gold Dome Building.” It was built in the Spanish Baroque style and is located next to the Garfield Conservatory! [Inspiration Kitchen](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=b682f446e7&e=e789b9d47e) is a social enterprise restaurant that provides job training to community members. Proceeds go directly to support programs that benefit those in need.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [PsiQuantum](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=18cc366e8c&e=e789b9d47e) recently announced they will create a 300,000 square foot Quantum Computer Operations Center near the Calumet River. [Birrieria Don Luis](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a7b817c0c1&e=e789b9d47e), open most days from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM is known for their birria ramen and especial quesataco!
---
|
---
| 📷 Psi Quantum
---
| | | | | | | | | | | The [Retro Grill Stony Island](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=2e0a6599c0&e=e789b9d47e), a family owned-business, serves up retro burgers, wings and shakes!
---
|
---
|
## Vendor Spotlights
---
| Open since 2003, [Vermilion](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=94e477d328&e=e789b9d47e) was featured on Chicago Magazine’s Hot List in 2020! The owner founded “Let’s Talk Womxn” in 2020 to help uplift and guide women restaurant-owners during the pandemic.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | [South Side Tours](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ce06057a0e&e=e789b9d47e) is an educational and entertaining media-based tour that showcases local residents' oral histories coupled with rich history facts to provide riders with an immersive experience of Chicago's South Side! Tours are offered Saturdays and Sundays promptly at 11:00 am and typically last around three hours.

---
| _If you’d like to be featured in our newsletter or social media channels, please sign up for our vendor directory and email us with your business name, logo, description, and a picture or video that best describes your business._
---
|
---
|
## Staff Spotlight
---
| This week’s staff spotlight is Operations Consultant, **Aaron Cartwright**!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Aaron joined the team as part of Magnify Strategies, hired to lead Chicago’s bid for the 2024 convention. Aaron grew up outside of the city in Wheaton, and currently lives in the Uptown neighborhood. His favorite activity is to go to Timber Lanes Bowling Alley in North Center. Outside of work, he likes to go to musicals, play golf and eat at [Laschet’s Inn](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=6c7bfd4f9d&e=e789b9d47e)!
---
|
---

This is our moment. No looking back.

He loves dogs. _And cats._ He also knows how to get things done. As Governor of Minnesota, Tim Walz only had a one-vote majority in the state legislature. But it’s going to take all of us to get them to the White House. Are you in? The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90336092/490178717/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODgxNTI3Ny0yZTU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P0HP9vgQVtCmmuXxoUfcxMO4I-8ad80Lkw4IBItJbPE=&emci=5dad667c-2654-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=c8815277-2e54-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=19445147)
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90336093/490178718/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODgxNTI3Ny0yZTU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P0HP9vgQVtCmmuXxoUfcxMO4I-8ad80Lkw4IBItJbPE=&emci=5dad667c-2654-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=c8815277-2e54-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=19445147)
Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.

---
Public school teachers have a special place in my heart — but that’s not the only reason I’m very happy with Governor Tim Walz as Vice President Harris’ running mate. As a former public school teacher, a veteran, and one of the most effective governors in America, he has a strong track record of putting government on the side of working families. Just look at the bills he’s signed in Minnesota. Capping the cost of insulin at $35. Ensuring paid family and medical leave. Protecting the right to an abortion. Requiring universal background checks for gun purchases. Providing free breakfast and lunch for public school students. The list goes on and on. And we know that Governor Walz fights from the heart. As someone whose family relied on Social Security survivor benefits after his father passed away, who went to college on the GI Bill, and whose family was able to access reproductive health care like IVF, he knows how our government can give people a fighting chance and protect our freedoms. Today, we get to celebrate the terrific choice that Vice President Harris just made. And for the next 91 days, we’ve got to do everything we can to help this ticket win so we can keep making big, structural change for working families in our country. [**I'm all in for Harris-Walz, and I’m running for re-election to fight by their side for working families in 2025 and beyond. _That has all proven to be true._
I also knew that our coalition, our movement, would come together and support one another as it has time and time again. You see, in 2020, I defeated a 52-year political dynasty; and in 2022, St. Louis sent me back to Congress with a strong mandate to champion racial, economic, reproductive, gender, health, and environmental justice. _And I did just that._

Fellow Conservative: Democrats want our borders to be overrun with _**illegal immigrants**_ so they can _**vote in our elections**_. This is no secret. Thankfully, these conservatives in the Senate are fighting to pass the SAVE Act, which would require states to (1) verify citizenship for federal elections and (2) purge non-citizens from their voter rolls. **▶︎ Mike Lee **(R-UT) **▶︎ J.D. name: Eric H. Holder Jr.
subject: The crown jewel of the civil rights movement
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
By working together, we can protect — and even enhance — our democracy.
|
---

Peter,
The Voting Rights Act of 1965 is the crown jewel of the civil rights movement.
When it was signed into law 59 years ago today, it was the culmination of perseverance, commitment, and people who gave their lives so that other people would have that right to vote. Proof that ordinary people can come together to make extraordinary progress.
While the Voting Rights Act never solved all of our democracy’s problems, it proved to be a powerful bulwark against those who would try to stop eligible voters from casting a ballot.
That all changed in 2013, when the conservative majority on the Supreme Court — led by Chief Justice John Roberts — invalidated key parts of the law, in what I believe to be an extremely wrongly decided decision. Without the preclearance requirement for states with a history of discrimination, some states rushed to pass strict new voting rules in an effort to lower turnout among communities of color.
It was a major blow. But Peter, as long as we've been a nation, we have been in a constant struggle about who makes the decisions about the policy and direction of the country.
Now, we must do all that we possibly can to ensure that, as Dr. King said, the moral arc of the universe bends towards justice. What we need to understand is that arc doesn't bend on its own. It only bends when people like us put our hands on that arc and pull it towards justice.
**Understand this: There's no cavalry coming. We are the cavalry.**
**So I ask you... _What are _you_ doing to pull that arc towards justice_?**
We have a sacred charge to uphold the Voting Rights Act and the legacy of those who gave their lives so that we may all have the right to vote. It’s an unfinished march, but I'm confident that by working together, we can protect — and even enhance — our democracy.
— Eric H. Holder, Jr.

clean_body: By working together, we can protect — and even enhance — our democracy. | Peter, The Voting Rights Act of 1965 is the crown jewel of the civil rights movement. When it was signed into law 59 years ago today, it was the culmination of perseverance, commitment, and people who gave their lives so that other people would have that right to vote. Proof that ordinary people can come together to make extraordinary progress. While the Voting Rights Act never solved all of our democracy’s problems, it proved to be a powerful bulwark against those who would try to stop eligible voters from casting a ballot. That all changed in 2013, when the conservative majority on the Supreme Court — led by Chief Justice John Roberts — invalidated key parts of the law, in what I believe to be an extremely wrongly decided decision. Without the preclearance requirement for states with a history of discrimination, some states rushed to pass strict new voting rules in an effort to lower turnout among communities of color. It was a major blow. But Peter, as long as we've been a nation, we have been in a constant struggle about who makes the decisions about the policy and direction of the country. Now, we must do all that we possibly can to ensure that, as Dr. King said, the moral arc of the universe bends towards justice. What we need to understand is that arc doesn't bend on its own. It only bends when people like us put our hands on that arc and pull it towards justice. Understand this: There's no cavalry coming. We are the cavalry. So I ask you... What are you doing to pull that arc towards justice? We have a sacred charge to uphold the Voting Rights Act and the legacy of those who gave their lives so that we may all have the right to vote. It’s an unfinished march, but I'm confident that by working together, we can protect — and even enhance — our democracy. — Eric H. body:
Our thoughts on the new VP choice for Democrats.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dem_vp_pick&n=1)
---
Peter,

If there is one campaign promise that Joe Biden kept, it was his promise to major donors that “Nothing will fundamentally change.”

Now it’s evident that Kamala Harris is carrying that promise forward into her campaign.

This morning Harris named Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz as her running mate. He was immediately embraced as a progressive champion by AOC and the mark of a return to “normalcy” from Joe Manchin.

There’s much we can say about Tim Walz’s supposedly progressive record, and we will. But the endorsement of his selection by Joe Manchin is the most telling of all.

**_Let’s talk about what “normalcy” means for Democrats.

_** It means making symbolic, low-risk gestures towards indigenous sovereignty like giving public park land back to Minnesota’s First Americans while **greenlighting Enron’s pipeline through tribal lands** and destroying critical water systems in the Mississippi River’s headwaters.

It means expressing public support for the right to protest while **calling the National Guard on your own citizens** protesting the violent police murder of George Floyd.

It means giving lip service to the ceasefire movement while **catering to the Zionist lobby and giving speeches at AIPAC**.

Without question, our opponent could have chosen a WORSE running mate. The pressure of the anti-genocide movement and the fierce, unrelenting advocacy to end this genocide and free Palestine was enough to keep the most ardent Zionist off the Democratic ticket.

But with an ongoing genocide waged with American dollars and American bombs; as the Middle East hovers on the brink of WW-III; with an accelerating climate emergency; and with an economy on the verge of a freefall that will once again crush working families – a straight-down-the-middle moderate Democrat like Tim Walz does not meet the moment.

It simply upholds the Democrats’ most ironclad promise: **_Nothing will fundamentally change.

_**[**It remains true that there is ONLY ONE anti-genocide, pro-peace, pro-worker, climate action campaign with a pathway to the White House this November – ours. We need your financial support to deliver our mandate at the ballot box.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dem_vp_pick&n=2)

The choice of a running mate is a profoundly important decision for a presidential campaign. You need someone who will be an effective and collaborative partner, with whom you share strong ideological bonds but who brings another perspective and different lived experiences to the job.

Our campaign is about addressing the urgent demands of the day while also building a sustainable society and livable future where everyone can thrive.

Our vice president cannot be someone content to maintain the status quo, as Walz will surely do for Harris. They must be someone who shares our fearless vision for the future within our reach.

We found the right one, and we can’t wait for you to meet them this Thursday. It’s true. As long as we continue electing Democrats, nothing will fundamentally change.

It means making symbolic, low-risk gestures towards indigenous sovereignty like giving public park land back to Minnesota’s First Americans while greenlighting Enron’s pipeline through tribal lands and destroying critical water systems in the Mississippi River’s headwaters. It means expressing public support for the right to protest while calling the National Guard on your own citizens protesting the violent police murder of George Floyd. It means giving lip service to the ceasefire movement while catering to the Zionist lobby and giving speeches at AIPAC. Without question, our opponent could have chosen a WORSE running mate. The pressure of the anti-genocide movement and the fierce, unrelenting advocacy to end this genocide and free Palestine was enough to keep the most ardent Zionist off the Democratic ticket. But with an ongoing genocide waged with American dollars and American bombs; as the Middle East hovers on the brink of WW-III; with an accelerating climate emergency; and with an economy on the verge of a freefall that will once again crush working families – a straight-down-the-middle moderate Democrat like Tim Walz does not meet the moment. It simply upholds the Democrats’ most ironclad promise: Nothing will fundamentally change. | "DONATE NOW" The choice of a running mate is a profoundly important decision for a presidential campaign. You need someone who will be an effective and collaborative partner, with whom you share strong ideological bonds but who brings another perspective and different lived experiences to the job. Our campaign is about addressing the urgent demands of the day while also building a sustainable society and livable future where everyone can thrive. Our vice president cannot be someone content to maintain the status quo, as Walz will surely do for Harris. They must be someone who shares our fearless vision for the future within our reach. We found the right one, and we can’t wait for you to meet them this Thursday. It’s true. As long as we continue electing Democrats, nothing will fundamentally change. In solidarity and gratitude, Jill | "Support Jill Today!" Minnesota Governor Tim Walz wanted to throw stones last week, describing President Trump and JD Vance as “[weird](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=b3170b6bbdcf40a58a00c1804b28d4b4&_e=xMOtBg-M6bU9HHr4uAxnzmoClr4tRlxsjxRrYygkRJruI_r52jRx8PKRySdPMSFoljmHHH_aEF45ibKjLuZIDJTLSoJgKpTRaweN75lJwJ6Aq_NDRbD7sS3NMinZWZSBFPcS9_EJycHZcIlfHcFhA9d28bi-8-vrL4TrPD6CdrO_EHTF10v8DuVqXu6deBn9Z49ybLOBNzlE86xUAEAKTdhHq9nCw8WWTCtSvzj9ToR5IOFyV2IpIPqIsOanQV0cpKIab5Oy_nhEOBFYITfjOEniMYXGYoXqNlsSr32-BTf6QsSeYSBPJ8-Dhqw3knA9),” but his own track record is a complete clown show. Like his Democrat colleagues, Walz is all about kissing up to the illegal aliens pouring in across our southern border. He’s given them [driver’s licenses](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=b3170b6bbdcf40a58a00c1804b28d4b4&_e=xMOtBg-M6bU9HHr4uAxnzpU9ew4ex_T0LATAqi9JrLiWadnQvxw7jgFIHDxmHfmw3feUCPMS9AjslcBiekZI5QrCKf_mjB959xUFypcG-hXCQVJwiPbxNdC70RYVYYpZLG1yj8BgcABbOPgTz0Cy519mVc9vnWL7LzRssOKEzE57OxZ7iIE5NTfZYMMjFrIrT1esrpqIDYWQqscHyNZIOS3L9JH3-egcioEzjB0KOtXDIlur2CRvDk1pd4VkCPv5_RRUv2O2TErppNdxd8YwXeTt5J0JssEsgsGPJgrBChTMH-ntzSIQw5DRD7UhD0Bi9cfpxSeN3xzcM-vzX13lNA%3D%3D) in the state of Minnesota—and he even signed off on adding [health care](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=b3170b6bbdcf40a58a00c1804b28d4b4&_e=xMOtBg-M6bU9HHr4uAxnzofBD8Y8_rH8mqLVE0x3xnPfloxLlZfGEteMt230zi7P2WYYESdrjAGd6gft7ESpbp65IwXosrAcWMSU1vMtjPfrH7gSXDVRKSFzmbReIPF5gdOenG3MIivPNZRu4MQvqOeLOKoWYXRQry-7DCUjtavqil_33IMOGWitierlZUo23EsY36n0nu_siOWKI_Qf37u6-E1TVYEKqjy9-XHYfZwbckBsn1F8z315WYjjOHRWw1kmGJ4t-Cj261t5tG-VgqHQxS5B_gFN0J2cXqTU9MkC-D6DZDZ6TYcS0cWtReop) and college tuition to their goody bag of freebies.
I wish I was done, but there are a couple other zingers you should know about. If Walz wants to talk about _weird_ , let’s chat about his bill requiring schools to stock [tampons](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=b3170b6bbdcf40a58a00c1804b28d4b4&_e=xMOtBg-M6bU9HHr4uAxnzoj9OYHX9KkT7gsaOd4l5NAeSxDRceajtJ253qTlgWr945gU_7cD3ZgMg60Wi9nbnSCpb-U4aFInxrEn3faQeaGqoNNwksSFw2jeR7AD31Xzna5J07qsOAw-rji-ZgWcg188rJ2EXOjyUFFd9XREZkMdo3lm53ZEOvcj_8s1aPxvvnJhH7B9Y4UYetlz9S-rX-H5x6PM0XjLlsQ22ENZpm6i8fcvRDzWcmSmupxaO2HJcDlUpYc7lwC5XEDlC1NMubcl_Rp4V6YrEwuclNv0F4A%3D) in boys’ bathrooms?! Yes, you read that correctly, and it gets worse... He also signed off on legislation that allows minors to receive [sex change operations](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=b3170b6bbdcf40a58a00c1804b28d4b4&_e=xMOtBg-M6bU9HHr4uAxnzuIkrfgiArJnkD9Fz6L672TSzl8Le1Red8sN8CZHXWwZglp73nyoTJ5voxLgvH8MWyXfHFyHYkVIaeqQf_V7UqOwO_iifB7wI5HNRnAqSL6E8GiScniptuadKJDJ_AkRh7bC9xxb9d-mGo5t_dpbXOzfezW1hyWB2LgFVIHttZ4dnMYJ0nRtE1JlhlzKxnEMubuNN0tJRgkjPLQxFzvgV8yb1jLzFFV169o2NuB102t9exhNsx224qP_XTSPq7RUzgZy-IvhiYspKhC0l5gfOTw%3D) and casually called socialism another form of good old fashioned “[neighborliness](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=b3170b6bbdcf40a58a00c1804b28d4b4&_e=xMOtBg-M6bU9HHr4uAxnzmoClr4tRlxsjxRrYygkRJpXrjRhjqWkrFILsNF8UWcTvCLCQvmeHyXnyeKXAMC-uIkFCNZ0azzj6WIGYzjogUw9M6xOJbdEBk7Auj0iv5i7qkTB_arPhYKfGD1Vgoj8muaTRwHlP9oFc7i7T_tS2plBUpZmYJy5BRnHH5Ec1i8Fy3VwqFhNwKZKzOiIlUivqNBn3aTnA56Twqts3NnfJfu1dzuJpeTLQLDEGbIQkHmKCobt2N9jkUQLGFAVT9Cqk18z95_SJJW3eYoXUu5kXmTR1KS7LzI6-yQsbI6Y3oUG).” **[**> >> Is this what you want coming to a town near you? I doubt it! I couldn’t be more excited that Kamala Harris has selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate! This dynamic duo is exactly what we need to energize our party and fight for the future of our country. Governor Walz brings a wealth of experience and a proven track record of fighting for everyday people. He’s a champion for critical issues such as protecting reproductive rights, ensuring LGBTQ freedoms, keeping our communities safe from gun violence, and safeguarding voting rights. These are the very values that we are fighting for in Tennessee, and as your Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, I am incredibly proud to share the ballot with such outstanding leaders. We’re lucky to be part of this moment of tremendous political possibility. Like me, Tim Walz is a former educator, and he said it best: _It reminds me a bit of the first day of school._ There is so much to hope for ahead of us, but let’s not forget, this fight is far from over. Far-right extremists like Marsha Blackburn and their wealthy special interest backers are going all out to defeat us. We have the momentum from our primary victory, but we need to keep it going strong to defeat her in November. ## New polling worth checking out:
Echelon Insights was in the field last week in 6 battleground states (AZ, GA, MI, NV, PA, WI) testing messaging on Kamala Harris. Patrick Ruffini from Echelon shared the following summary of their finds.
Kamala's specific failures on crime and the border tied to real-world examples of making our communities less safe concerned voters the most across the board, over-indexing strongly among women, nonwhite voters, and persuadable voters. Her raising money for a Minnesota bail fund in 2020 and letting MS-13 gang members go free as DA -- [already highlighted by the Trump campaign ](https://substack.com/redirect/cd022762-782b-4fe2-93a6-d7f9634331f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- tested #1 and 2. While Harris' tenure as border czar tested slightly behind in overall concern, it showed the most intensity, tied for the highest number of those extremely concerned.
Highlighting Harris' extreme liberal ideology also resonated but with more mixed results. The "too liberal" line needs to be tied to specific issues and to negative outcomes people can see in their lives. Messaging solely focused on an inside-baseball ranking of Senators performed worst, especially with the lower-propensity voter groups.
We also tested a variation calling Harris "too extreme" rather than "too liberal." This version did no better overall but the "extreme" language did relatively better among women and White College voters, but it did worse among Black and Hispanic voters.

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, last month, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF
and our right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee
access to IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion
agenda.”

I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big
Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our
doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose
to build and raise OUR families.

And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the
ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours —
could be made impossible.

Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom,
and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our
freedoms. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S.
Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please add a donation to Lucas Kunce’s
campaign today so we can secure our freedoms?

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65684?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1010&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]Contribute $10
