[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1016&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]Give another amount

I warned you already this was a long email, so you can’t blame me for
wanting to tell you a bit more about Lucas Kunce and why I know he can
defeat Josh Hawley — but only if he has your help. Lucas is the Marine
veteran and born-and-raised Missourian taking Hawley on this November.
He’s built a record-breaking movement and is drawing huge crowds at events
across the state.

And he’s even sharing the ballot this November with a referendum to end
the Hawley-backed abortion ban in Missouri, which will be a huge boost for
Democratic turnout just as it has been in red and purple states across the
country in recent elections.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1017&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]New York Times headline: Abortion Rights Fuel Big Democratic Wins, and
Hopes for 2024

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1018&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]CHIP IN TO ELECT LUCAS

Not long ago, Missourians came together to defeat Todd Akin after his
extreme views on abortion came to light, but that didn’t happen overnight.

Akin exposed himself in August of that election year, and a poll that same
month showed him with an 11% lead. It took weeks and MONTHS of hard work,
advertising, and organizing to expose Akin’s extremism to Missouri voters
— and because we all came together, Missourians rejected Akin on Election
Day by a 15% margin (a total change of 26% from August).

And while you might be surprised to hear about Democrats doing that well
in a red state, that kind of result isn’t rare in Missouri.

In our last U.S. Senate race that took place in a presidential election,
Jason Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by 16%, nearly defeating
incumbent Roy Blunt, who had the entire GOP establishment behind him. In
fact, the race against Blunt got close with almost identical timing to the
race against Akin — Kander was polling by as much as 14% behind Blunt, but
after pushing hard on ads and organizing starting in the fall, the race
was neck-and-neck.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1019&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]On top, a Spectrum News headline: Recent poll found Hawley was the
least popular GOP senator up for reelection among voters. In the middle,
AP headline: Missouri abortion-rights campaign turns in more than double
the needed signatures to get on the ballot. On the bottom, a quote from
Jason Kander in the KC Star: 'Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley. Anyone
who cares about democracy, reproductive freedom, and working families,
this race should be a priority.'

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65683?refcode=em20240806-7267&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=7267%2E614464%2EqNTBXc ]CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY

Now I’m going to say something you may not want to hear, but it is true
and important for this race: Josh Hawley is more extreme than Donald Trump
and almost every Republican on reproductive freedom. In fact, he
objectively has the worst record on reproductive rights of any U.S.
Senator. That means we don’t have to wait for Hawley to have a “Todd Akin
moment” — his entire six years in the Senate has been one.

But it’s an election year, which means Josh Hawley will be telling all
sorts of lies to voters claiming he’s not responsible for this assault on
our freedoms. And that’s where you and me come in.

Thousands of Ohioans were unable to cast a valid vote after showing up to their polling place only to discover that their identification wasn’t accepted. **We can thank the Ohio GOP for that**. After the 2020 election, they passed some of the strictest voting laws in the country to limit the IDs that Ohioans can use to prove their identities.

So, where do we go from here?

| Peter,

Maggie believes that Congress can and must be on the frontlines of the fight to ensure a fair deal for ALL Granite Staters. That means:

🏥 Protecting Social Security, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act while taking on big health insurers and Big Pharma and expanding access to affordable healthcare and prescription drugs so we can secure healthcare as a right for all.

💼 Building a tax system that works for hard-working Granite Staters by delivering tax breaks for hard-working families instead of billionaires and big corporations, protecting workers’ rights, strengthening our union's power to collectively bargain, and raising the minimum wage.

🌎 Combating the climate crisis, helping advance environmental justice for overburdened and underserved communities by standing up to Big Oil, and working to close tax loopholes that have allowed Big Oil to make record profits while hard-working families face record prices at the pump.

My dad immigrated here from Mexico and worked all kinds of jobs to put food on the table for our family. 2. **I’m proud to be delivering results for Oregon families.** I’m one of the only representatives to pass legislation in this chaotic, extremist-run Congress. And I’m fighting every day to build an economy that puts working families before corporations — and to protect our fundamental freedoms like the right to choose.

3. **My opponent’s agenda couldn’t be more different.** He wants to ban abortion with no exceptions, cut programs like Medicaid and Social Security that help millions of families, and give tax breaks to millionaires like himself.

4. **Far-right super PACs are targeting this seat because it holds the key to deciding the House.** The NRCC just dumped $6,060,000 into our media market — more than any media market in the entire country. 5. **Your donation makes a real difference.** Like I said, our grassroots supporters are keeping the lights on. This race is actually a rematch between me and the very same opponent I faced in 2022. I won that race with 50.1% of the vote, so, yes — every dollar really does go a long, long way.

clean_body: | | | | | Fellow Patriot, I've heard a lot of politicians talk about "defending our country" and "fighting for freedom." But it's ironic: most of them have never lifted a finger for anyone but themselves. I'm sick of career politicians driving our great country down the gutter. It's time for something different. My name is Hung Cao. I'm a 25 -year Navy veteran, LEGAL immigrant, and candidate for the U.S. Senate in Virginia. Unlike most politicians today, I've actually seen what it's like to fight for freedom. As a Navy Captain, I went to some of the most dangerous war zones in the world like Iraq, Afghanistan and Somalia fighting terrorists in face-to-face combat. I've seen how much America's enemies will do anything to take us down, and I'm not about to let our weak President hand it over to them. When you're serving our nation in the deserts of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia, you have to remember what you’re fighting for. I fought for my five children, my beautiful wife, and the country that I owe my life to. You see, my family came to America after we escaped communism in Vietnam. My father was put on a kill list, and if it wasn’t for America welcoming us, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I chose to fight for our country in the Navy because I owe my life to America. Now, I'm carrying on that fight for our freedom, but I can't do it alone. Kamala Harris has chosen Governor Tim Walz to be her running mate! We now have our Democratic ticket.

Vice President Harris and Governor Tim Walz are the leaders we need in the White House.

Hi Friend, Do you often stop to consider what really matters in life? What does it mean to live a fruitful life? As believers we know that a life void of true connection to God is meaningless. Even a life with temporary success or worldly fame apart from God is a mark of an empty life. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=59598c834dc14ae2a8cbb778c8cdd7c7&_e=DlRYUPk0H9ou9K3hP0hZfmRA8EU4_KZrSnbyUJhzfxaZFZYAH97-Lde4jIdUO8pcKFevPna_QIu0GRfACTai3c5Wxu2_NEftUjW5c8Bbmn6sXGpGlNvJzky-nnDAZdScfst0iRLOIM1cHAZKRLfEwCw-ERz0l2iFrjBspx_I2X5gDZysqfYSRgG0_gIbdYYw3116B_BZAEubS8lWsd1BYIkR0dYm6LLdgg5o3fhmIxIw_uYSJTpV9OGiBhuNyXrePeMHk0rtP6NJXbR60bnu5EU4Ct855GQcyQwjK_QNJzeETwDSZ-qIYH2UNpmyKthl)
__ Fruitful Christian living boils down to one word--abiding. The most important thing that any believer can do is to abide in Christ. As we abide, His Word takes root in our hearts and bears fruit in our lives.

Peter,
Ahead of tonight’s 8pm ballot submission deadline in the Washington primary, I’ve been working to get out the vote and hear from as many people as possible.
I kicked off the final weekend with a GOTV event for the Washington Democrats along with my friends **Shasti Conrad** , **Sen. Emily Alvarado** , and our attorney general and next governor, **Bob Ferguson!**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240806-2.vP_HeC&refcode=em20240806-4178&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4178%2E420207%2EHibehi)
Then, I spent the morning door knocking in Burien with my friend **Dave Upthegrove**. Don’t forget to vote for both me and Dave on the primary ballot!
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240806-2.vP_HeC&refcode=em20240806-4178&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4178%2E420207%2EHibehi)
On Sunday, we canvassed with the WA Coordinated Campaign in the 34th legislative district, and it was incredible to see so much energy and enthusiasm going into the primary!
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240806-2.vP_HeC&refcode=em20240806-4178&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4178%2E420207%2EHibehi)
Last night, we had the Progressives for Harris call, and today we’ll be working the phones and knocking on doors right up until 8pm to make sure as many voters as possible submit their ballots.
**It’s crunch time, Peter, and I’m doing everything I can to continue advancing our shared progressive agenda.**
[**Will you help support our campaign ahead of tonight’s 8pm ballot submission deadline by making a grassroots donation of $3 today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240806-2.vP_HeC&refcode=em20240806-4178&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4178%2E420207%2EHibehi)

**LET’S WIN THIS.**
The excitement for our official Democratic presidential ticket is palpable in Philadelphia tonight! 💪
Governor Tim Walz has a loaded resume. Walz has been a geography teacher, high school football coach, faculty advisor for a gay-straight alliance, winner of purple district elections, and a fantastic governor (legalized recreational marijuana, protected abortion rights, expanded voting access).
Needless to say, I am all in for Kamala Harris + Tim Walz and am committed to electing this ticket in November.

Fellow American.

When my parents left South Vietnam after the fall of Saigon, there was a collective feeling in the family that we would never again face the dangers associated with communism or the inherent risks facing citizens in countries with one-party rule.

By most standards, my family's successful integration into U.S. society has been remarkable. My own story could only have unfolded the way it has in America. **I am Hung Cao, the son of two Vietnamese refugees and the 2024 Republican U.S. Senate nominee for Virginia.**

I'm a retired Navy Captain and Naval Academy graduate who spent more than 25 years serving in the Special Operations directorate in the U.S. Navy. In 2022, I came within striking distance of taking down one of the Democrat's most liberal House members in increasingly blue Northern Virginia. I lost that race by the slimmest of margins, but I'm not one to be deterred by defeat, and now I've set my sights on a new target: U.S. Senator Tim Kaine, Hillary Clinton's VP pick.

Fellow American, Tim Kaine might not be a household name like other Democrats running for reelection to the Senate. Still, as one of the ultimate Washington insiders and confidant to Democrat luminaries like Hillary Clinton, he was well aware of Joe Biden's health failing and said nothing.

**My opponent is complicit in the biggest coverup in recent American memory.**

body:
VoteVets gets leaders with competence, capability, and a proven record of service and dedication to this country elected. VoteVets members serve the public at every level — from school boards and local offices and, now, all the way up to the Democratic candidate for Vice President of the United States.
#
[
---
Peter, this is Tammy Duckworth. In just a moment I am going to ask you to make a donation to VoteVets now that my friend and VoteVets member Tim Walz has been tapped as Kamala Harris’ running mate. Please, let me explain why VoteVets — and your support — was critical to Tim’s career and will play an important role in the election this November. Back in 2006, Tim Walz was a teacher, he was a Veteran and he was running for Congress in a red district that no one thought he had a shot at winning. But VoteVets took notice and they ran $115,000 in advertisements to help defeat Tim’s opponent. Tim won that race, he’s kept on winning and VoteVets has had his back ever since. It’s the same story with me. Since my first campaign, VoteVets is one of the organizations that I have always been able to count on. It’s the same story with thousands of candidates from around the country. VoteVets gets leaders with competence, capability and a proven record of service and dedication to this country elected. VoteVets members serve the public at every level — from school boards and local offices and, now, all the way up to the Democratic candidate for Vice President of the United States. **So please, friend, rush $5, or whatever you can spare, and help us reach our urgent Big Sky Buckeye Fund of $500,000 by midnight.**
Here's the best link to give: **[https://sherrodbrown.com/donate/big-sky-buckeye-fund](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90345418/490211351/938446010?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2421-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTAzYjU0ZS00ODU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MaDDkKY72Mx4T7QV32XL60L-UbfyXj-0FXcPVU0x2O4=)**

Hi folks,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re just **100 days** away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.
And we need your help.
Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But our multimillionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.
We can’t write our campaigns million-dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: you. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers – you name it – who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.
We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.
[**That’s why we’ve set a rapid-response Big Sky Buckeye Fund goal to raise $500,000 at this critical moment. Peter,

I’m thrilled to congratulate my friend Tim Walz on his selection as Kamala Harris’s running mate.

I’ve worked with Tim for nearly two decades. We were elected to Congress in the same class in 2006, and we’ve served the state of Minnesota together since 2019. I know firsthand he’s the perfect choice to help lead our entire ticket to resounding victory on November 5.
Tim’s exceptional dedication and transformative impact on Minnesota makes him uniquely qualified to tell the story of what America’s future can look like on the national stage.

Under Tim’s leadership, Minnesota made school meals free for every student, passed paid leave for working families, enacted robust gun safety measures, and so much more. His accomplishments are a testament to his dedication to putting people first.

Tim represents the best of public service. He brings together the courage of a veteran, the compassion of a school teacher, the determination of a state champion football coach, and the deep experience of both a congressman and governor. Tim is as genuine as they come—what you see is truly what you get.

Peter,

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=1c2570eac2b04d1ab16a15e67e7e793f&_e=r_-7xwo-zPoi7D-nKHJIQPpZ-dojJAeh74GCkiYV1RiNMic3aIcKKAuuGc9kX2Jmi3Cwkz290mp3qJay4RJ_aE0rN1O5-iXeFrrE8wonlgLvpIblXlGob8ELE30LSPjoPDFnXgLRR0bNrpGrrsdGRyuJ_aelxPUlthQH7cULqy4XD_QzlC2L2hQ23Yob1_KPOghspYBaOhExvy5ybyOM_K7Dr3pJKwni_Z624fQBqnRcWIrJBNxy-a923ZhF1Ru7V6eKQ_FqByCc7QW2AsbIZA_RYUPI5Nk-EQvq0r5qIWvUh-pqFlUsK9XHZiA3jB5aWlu5DraQ_sXfomiDw_P2WHjcg1eOngUCDPND7hiGnZJYq31bel78aPU3wqjyG1t7tD5hXgInZqPLisg8oZnCbBAr8qDhG9RBBCNrEaKbOOOjLw-bNa2a7xQMEtMxfogB) [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=1c2570eac2b04d1ab16a15e67e7e793f&_e=r_-7xwo-zPoi7D-nKHJIQPpZ-dojJAeh74GCkiYV1RiNMic3aIcKKAuuGc9kX2Jmi3Cwkz290mp3qJay4RJ_aE0rN1O5-iXeFrrE8wonlgLvpIblXlGob8ELE30LSPjoPDFnXgLRR0bNrpGrrsdGRyuJ_aelxPUlthQH7cULqy4XD_QzlC2L2hQ23Yob1_KPOghspYBaOhExvy5ybyOM_K7Dr3pJKwni_Z624fQBqnRcWIrJBNxy-a923ZhF1Ru7V6eKQ_FqByCc7QW2AsbIZM8RmKwn4VvaRzC2PLSd9i7r_Q5RtYk_J8ucPRGUNC0Hy6bnl_ivYd6pAFJPFu5HjR9kq_CuOfOIfWtZLlCID9O1B6og3XoH9zQkhM4Y7X_lhb8xPRPqqU2POZV5RUm5DFseQPtDNrUwc0eQEB0TGytB2GeD6UeEsez-xtJkDjI2) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=1c2570eac2b04d1ab16a15e67e7e793f&_e=r_-7xwo-zPoi7D-nKHJIQPpZ-dojJAeh74GCkiYV1RiNMic3aIcKKAuuGc9kX2Jmi3Cwkz290mp3qJay4RJ_aE0rN1O5-iXeFrrE8wonlgLvpIblXlGob8ELE30LSPjoPDFnXgLRR0bNrpGrrsdGRyuJ_aelxPUlthQH7cULqy4XD_QzlC2L2hQ23Yob1_KPOghspYBaOhExvy5ybyOM_K7Dr3pJKwni_Z624fQBqnRcWIrJBNxy-a923ZhF1Ru7V6eKQ_FqByCc7QW2AsbIZJvrdT0Lw3Zpwv4YmesKyzxB0QgOCF9U7JTHq8XtHMXkN3yF2XZvsHYMg8t54tiQ8783ICsjU-IsC9P7tonKPjrNG_2iARgReUF42q14HeJ0NXwoiqNgA98wEPpUwUOnLHQZWBxEwlG8pARSikmBtDhiKUOdbrpLduC6S38ulhN_)

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=5a666905dbc44e78890a9223e7f1c347&_e=w0PlSSW5smzYFZeDXNAeCSf770WGekrWfXDcROJwcoOJPw12J6NYzADWfCjSJ6UnnHISlXasgqIBjgT3Q81wMNyYkSHwENl_dziftKJot96IzPzLgdasQoNyEcJMN1r5GrZEdJ_echFFRCQAl0YrZd0LO4z6O8-dG-KXLbgWDzU1wEoiRFJYO8tCXDn0bA-gsEPmVD1JnnDkFsz11GpXOIEBcESebhXs4fawuGLj52LuS9es38fJ462EHGQzAsc5w_UkV1oU3QltPHkQ9h4HPOjfQEzpcKop95w-o6cxetU_nCjx4jG7qM376MUNkSVJPYqedtx72dbvnUdu3fr8ML_rcqVds4PyHw6IQVoteYFhWpvRFnCA1NnuiY2AEjnnO9z_xcsfQxdXZdTmrVkSatsVr1goFOxPuUR-LulHt_wHMk2zvxWnur_xdBg9A192) [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=5a666905dbc44e78890a9223e7f1c347&_e=w0PlSSW5smzYFZeDXNAeCSf770WGekrWfXDcROJwcoOJPw12J6NYzADWfCjSJ6UnnHISlXasgqIBjgT3Q81wMNyYkSHwENl_dziftKJot96IzPzLgdasQoNyEcJMN1r5GrZEdJ_echFFRCQAl0YrZd0LO4z6O8-dG-KXLbgWDzU1wEoiRFJYO8tCXDn0bA-gsEPmVD1JnnDkFsz11GpXOIEBcESebhXs4fawuGLj52LuS9es38fJ462EHGQzAsc5w_UkV1oU3QltPHkQ9h4HPNE7wyYDupL6v5xh-TdjRnFxgmTaEfO-6H1B66Lvqq86yk3HlMMWHcwV9DnmzcxgwaQKnr-V5lzfjaNnpRAXTq1CfDHzgqRPE1qt-5wUt2HRDh4I5vRgLF0yFzBRBV21YLnQh7xvQsBj4u5KS6Z3U2GUoglEBFttk1N6RkBOJrzN) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

clean_body: [] Dear Peter, We are delighted to share some exciting news with you! Vice President Kamala Harris has announced Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her Vice Presidential pick for the upcoming election. Governor Walz’s dedication to education, healthcare, and economic growth, along with his commitment to inclusivity, makes him an excellent partner for Vice President Harris. Together, they will work to build a stronger, more inclusive nation for all Americans. Want to get to know him? Here's just some of the incredible work he's done in Minnesota: Governor Walz is a champion for America’s working families. A former football coach who took his team to the state championship for the first time in the school's history and a Command Sergeant Major in the Army National Guard who went to college on the GI Bill, he won his first race in a Republican district by representing the needs of farmers and rural America. In Congress, he took action for veterans and forged compromise to get things done. As governor, he has done more to help middle class families get ahead than any other statewide leader in recent memory. Governor Walz fights and delivers for working families like the one he grew up in. He signed the largest tax cut in state history. He lowered the cost of insulin to $35 per month. He eliminated junk fees. And, he signed paid leave into law so that parents can take care of sick family without losing their job. * Governor Walz has stood up for our fundamental freedoms: making Minnesota the first state to pass a law codifying abortion rights after the Supreme Court overturned Roe. The most important and competitive race in San Diego continues to heat up. The San Diego Union Tribune [noted and wrote](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=3561438e7e&e=784f78234b) about our campaign outpacing incumbent Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer in fundraising for the second consecutive quarter. I worked with a majority Democrat city council to get things done when I was mayor. Whether it was reducing homelessness, creating more housing, protecting our environment, or making San Diego the safest city in the country – I led and delivered on the issues that mattered to all our communities.
It’s time to end the inaction and deliver results. And that’s what I’ll do as your next Supervisor.

Kevin
